questions.stem: The table below shows the market shares of the four largest firms in Country A’s live fish market in a certain year.

choices.text: monopolistic competition ... firms can freely enter or exit the market
monopolistic competition ... there is no dominant firm in the market
oligopoly ... the firms are interdependent in their marketing strategies

questions.explanation: The four largest firms together hold only 18%, with 82% shared by others, so there is no dominant seller. This can be consistent with monopolistic competition; the table gives no evidence of free entry, product differentiation or interdependence.
questions.postVisualStem: According to the above table, the market structure of Country A’s live fish market could be regarded as __________ because __________.

questions.chapterTitle: Efficiency, Equity and the Role of Government (I)
questions.keyPoint: Rationing function
questions.stem: A fan sells a football bearing a star player's autograph to the highest bidder on an auction website. The case illustrates the __________ function of price because __________.

choices.text: allocative ... more resources can be allocated to football production
allocative ... price can convey information about consumer preferences
rationing ... the football is obtained by the buyer willing to pay the highest price
rationing ... this arrangement allows the fan to earn the highest profit

questions.explanation: The scarce football is allocated to the bidder willing to pay the highest price, which is the rationing function of price.

questions.chapterTitle: Efficiency, Equity and the Role of Government (I)
questions.keyPoint: Maximisation of total social surplus: marginal benefit equals marginal cost
questions.stem: When __________, overproduction will occur.

choices.text: the price is above the equilibrium price
the marginal social cost of the last unit is greater than the marginal social benefit
the quantity demanded is greater than the quantity supplied

questions.explanation: Overproduction means the last units cost society more than they benefit it, so marginal social cost exceeds marginal social benefit.

questions.chapterTitle: Efficiency, Equity and the Role of Government (I)
questions.topicGroup: With the aid of a demand-supply diagram, analyse the effects of market interventions on consumer surplus, producer surplus and efficiency
questions.keyPoint: Price ceiling
questions.stem: The following is the demand-supply diagram for good X. E0 is the initial equilibrium point.
questions.explanation: P1 is an effective ceiling. Consumer surplus rises by P1bcd and producer surplus falls by P1bE0d. The producer-surplus loss is larger, so total social surplus falls and deadweight loss is dcE0.

visuals.alt: Demand-supply diagram with effective price ceiling P1 below equilibrium E0, labelled areas a, b, c and d.
visuals.caption: Price ceiling, surpluses and deadweight loss

movements: The ceiling P1 is below equilibrium and therefore effective.
diagramDetails.answerFocus: Consumer surplus rises by P1bcd, producer surplus falls by P1bE0d, and deadweight loss is dcE0.

questions.postVisualStem:
If the government sets a price ceiling of P1 for good X,

(1) consumer surplus will increase by area P1bcd.
(2) producer surplus will decrease by area P1bE0d.
(3) total social surplus may increase, decrease or remain unchanged.

questions.chapterTitle: Efficiency, Equity and the Role of Government (II)
questions.keyPoint: Interpret the information delivered from the Gini coefficient
questions.stem: The table below shows Country A’s Gini coefficient in 2020 and 2025.

choices.text: Country A provided more social transfers in 2025 compared with 2020.
the Lorenz curve based on original household income in 2025 is closer to perfect equality than in 2020.
the number of low-income households decreased while the number of high-income households increased.
taxes and social transfers have improved income inequality in Country A.

questions.explanation: For each year, the post-tax, post-transfer Gini coefficient is lower than the original-income coefficient, showing that taxes and social transfers make income more even. The data do not show transfer amounts or household counts, and original-income inequality increased from 2020 to 2025.

visuals.caption: Country A Gini coefficients
rows: Gini coefficient based on original household income
Gini coefficient based on post-tax post-social transfer household income

questions.postVisualStem: Based on the above information, we can conclude that

questions.keyPoint: Meaning of scarcity
questions.stem:
Which of the following situations imply the existence of scarcity?

(1) People have to make choices among options.
(2) People are unable to obtain the goods or services they want even if they are willing to pay the price.
(3) People have to pay a cost to obtain certain goods or services.
questions.explanation: Choices reveal resources are insufficient relative to wants; inability to buy at the stated price is a shortage, which implies scarcity; and paying a cost means the goods are economic goods. All three imply scarcity.

questions.keyPoint: Explain whether and how cost changes under different circumstances
questions.stem:
Mr. Lam is a fresh university graduate who is planning his career path after graduation. He has several options and his order of preference is shown below:

First option: to work as a customer relations officer in a bank
Second option: to study for a master's degree at a university
Third option: to create short videos full-time and upload them to an online video platform

Which of the following factors would be LEAST likely to affect Mr. Lam's cost-benefit analysis for his choice?

choices.text: The online video platform reduces the proportion of advertising revenue shared with creators.
Salaries for new bank employees have generally decreased.
More banks expand their customer relations departments.
The teaching quality of the master's programme is poorer than Mr. Lam expected.

questions.explanation: Mr. Lam chooses the bank job because its value exceeds the value of his next-best option, the master's degree. A lower value of the third option does not alter either the benefit of the first option or its opportunity cost.

questions.topicGroup: Distinction between positive statements and normative statements
questions.keyPoint: Distinction between positive statements and normative statements
questions.stem:
Which of the following statements is/are normative statement(s)?

(1) Distributing consumption vouchers to tourists has greater benefits than costs for Hong Kong.
(2) Waiving the examination fees for all Hong Kong Diploma of Secondary Education candidates is a fair measure.
(3) Setting standard working hours does not help reduce income inequality.
questions.explanation: Only statement (2) uses the value judgement 'fair'. Statements (1) and (3) can be tested against facts, so they are positive statements.

questions.topicGroup: Types of goods and services produced
questions.keyPoint: Private goods and public goods
questions.stem: Some restaurants offer free drinks for customers to enjoy while waiting to be seated. These drinks are ___________.

choices.text: free goods because people obtain them without incurring any cost
economic goods if they satisfy people's wants
private goods because they are rival in consumption
producer goods if the restaurant can exclude non-customers from enjoying these drinks

questions.explanation: When one customer consumes a drink, fewer drinks remain for others. The drinks are therefore rival in consumption and are private goods; free of charge does not make them free goods.

questions.chapterTitle: The Three Basic Economic Problems and Private Property Rights
questions.keyPoint: The meanings of the three basic economic problems and examples of the problems
questions.stem:
With more fitness centres opening branches in various districts, a fitness equipment manufacturer has decided to reduce the production of home fitness equipment and lower its selling price at the same time.

The above decision of the fitness equipment manufacturer is related to the ___________ question in economics because it is related to ___________.

(1) 'what to produce' ... the choice of the quantity of outputs
(2) 'how to produce' ... the method of production
(3) 'for whom to produce' ... the distribution of inputs
questions.explanation: Reducing production concerns the quantity of output and therefore what to produce. A lower selling price affects who buys the output, but it is not the distribution of inputs described in statement (3).

questions.keyPoint: Comparison of features, advantages and disadvantages of different forms of ownership
questions.stem:
Miss Cheung is the owner of a firm. The firm is an independent legal entity and its shares cannot be freely transferred on the stock exchange. If the firm winds up,

(1) Miss Cheung does not need to bear the legal responsibilities of the firm.
(2) Miss Cheung's loss is confined to the amount she invested in the firm.
(3) Miss Cheung can claim repayment of her investment in the firm prior to bondholders.
questions.explanation: The firm is a private limited company. It has separate legal personality and shareholders have limited liability, but bondholders rank before shareholders when the company winds up.

questions.keyPoint: Functions of money
questions.stem:
Which of the following may exist in a barter economy?

(1) division of labour
(2) private property rights
(3) inflation
questions.explanation: Division of labour and private property rights can exist without money. Inflation requires a persistent rise in the general money price level, which cannot exist in a barter economy.

questions.keyPoint: Productivity of labour
questions.stem:
Suppose the government of Country A decides to increase the quota of its foreign talent admission scheme.

This will cause Country A's ___________ and ___________ to increase.

choices.text: labour supply ... geographical mobility of labour
geographical mobility of labour ... average labour productivity
occupational mobility of labour ... average labour productivity

questions.explanation: More foreign talent enters Country A's labour market, increasing its labour supply. Their education and experience can raise average labour productivity; the scheme does not necessarily change Country A workers' geographical or occupational mobility.

questions.topicGroup: Input-output relationship in the short run
questions.keyPoint: Law of diminishing marginal returns
questions.stem: The following table shows the production plan of a firm. The firm employs two factors only, namely labour and machinery.
questions.explanation: Total product rises from 18 to 30, 48 and 65 as machinery increases. The fifth machine has marginal product 17, so the sixth must have marginal product below 17. Thus X must be below 13.67; 12 is possible.
questions.postVisualStem: If the above data illustrates the law of diminishing marginal returns, the value of X _________.

questions.chapterTitle: The Objectives and Expansion of Firms
questions.keyPoint: Understand the meaning and give examples of each type of integration
questions.stem:
A Western restaurant is considering acquiring a food importer or opening a new branch in a shopping mall with many restaurants.

Based on the above information, which of the following could be (a) possible reason(s) for the restaurant choosing to acquire a food importer instead of opening a new branch?

(1) to reduce the number of competitors in the market
(2) to ensure a reliable supply of inputs
(3) to enjoy economies of scale
questions.explanation: Acquiring an input supplier is vertical backward integration and can ensure a reliable supply of inputs. It does not remove restaurant competitors, and either expansion option can create economies of scale.

questions.chapterTitle: The Objectives and Expansion of Firms
questions.topicGroup: The basic objective of firms: profit maximisation
questions.keyPoint: Profit-maximising choice of output for a competitive firm
questions.stem: The table below shows the cost-output relationship of a price-taking firm. The fixed cost of the firm is $5.

choices.text: the profit-maximising output will increase from 4 units to 6 units.
the profit of the firm will increase by $8.
the total cost of the firm will increase by $35.
the firm will suffer from diseconomies of scale.

questions.explanation: Total cost at four units is $24 and at five units is $35. The profit-maximising output rises from four at $9 to five at $11, and profit rises from $12 to $20, an increase of $8.
questions.postVisualStem: According to the table above, when the market price increases from $9 to $11,

questions.topicGroup: Determination of equilibrium price and output
questions.keyPoint: Market disequilibrium: excess demand and excess supply
questions.stem:
A luxury brand launches a limited-edition watch. Some fans of the brand are willing to pay the listed price and spend time queuing, but they still find that the watches are sold out.

From the information above, we can infer that the quantity transacted of the watches is __________.

choices.text: equal to the quantity supplied and smaller than the quantity demanded
equal to the quantity supplied and larger than the quantity demanded
equal to the quantity demanded and smaller than the quantity supplied
equal to the quantity demanded and larger than the quantity supplied

questions.explanation: The sold-out watches show excess demand: quantity demanded exceeds quantity supplied. The quantity actually transacted therefore equals the smaller quantity supplied.

questions.topicGroup: Money Price (Nominal Price) and Relative Price
questions.keyPoint: Explain phenomena by applying the law of demand (using relative price or full price)
questions.stem: Country A mainly imports fruit from Country B. Suppose the government of Country B requires stronger packaging for each box of exported fruit. Which of the following statements is CORRECT?

choices.text: Country A's demand for fruit from Country B will decrease.
The proportion of high-quality fruit sold in Country A will increase.
Country A's total expenditure on fruit will decrease.
The change in the import volume of fruit depends on the price elasticity of demand.

questions.explanation: Higher packaging cost lowers the relative price of high-quality fruit compared with ordinary fruit, so consumers buy more high-quality fruit relative to ordinary fruit. The policy reduces supply rather than demand, while expenditure depends on price elasticity and import volume falls.

questions.topicGroup: Changes in both demand and supply
questions.keyPoint: Explain the effects of a change in demand and a change in supply on equilibrium price and quantity
questions.stem:
The supply curve of good X is upward sloping and its demand curve is vertical.

Suppose the supply of good X increases while demand decreases, and the extent of the increase in supply is greater than the decrease in demand. As a result,

choices.text: the equilibrium price of good X will decrease, while the equilibrium quantity may increase, decrease or remain unchanged.
the equilibrium price of good X may increase, decrease or remain unchanged, while the equilibrium quantity will decrease.
both the equilibrium price and equilibrium quantity of good X will decrease.
both the equilibrium price and equilibrium quantity of good X will increase.

questions.explanation: With vertical demand, a supply increase lowers price but leaves quantity unchanged. A demand decrease lowers both price and quantity. Therefore both equilibrium price and quantity decrease.

questions.topicGroup: Changes in both demand and supply
questions.keyPoint: Explain the effects of a change in demand and a change in supply on equilibrium price and quantity
questions.stem: Refer to the following supply-demand diagram for bus services in Country A. The initial equilibrium point is E0.
questions.explanation: Lower driver salaries increase bus-service supply from S0 to S1. The railway is a substitute, so bus-service demand decreases from D0 to D2. The new equilibrium is E3.

visuals.alt: Bus-services demand and supply diagram with demand curves D0 to D2, supply curves S0 to S2 and equilibrium points E0 to E4.
visuals.caption: Bus-services market shifts

movements: Lower bus-driver salaries shift supply right from S0 to S1.
The new railway line shifts demand left from D0 to D2.
diagramDetails.answerFocus: The two shifts move equilibrium from E0 to E3, so option C is correct.

questions.postVisualStem: Suppose the salaries of bus drivers generally fall, and at the same time, a new railway branch line officially opens and covers the operating area of the bus services. The new equilibrium point will be ___________.

questions.chapterTitle: Price Elasticity of Demand and Supply
questions.keyPoint: Relationship between price elasticity of demand and total revenue
questions.stem:
In which of the following situations will consumers' total expenditure on good X decrease?

(1) Good X and good Y are in joint demand, and the price of raw materials for producing good Y increases.
(2) Good X and good Y are substitutes, and the government imposes a per-unit tax on good Y.
(3) The government increases the effective quota set on good X, and the demand for good X is inelastic.
questions.explanation: In (1), costlier Y reduces demand for jointly demanded X, lowering both price and quantity. In (3), a higher quota lowers price and raises quantity; with inelastic demand, the percentage price fall is larger and expenditure falls. In (2), demand for X rises because Y is a substitute.

questions.chapterTitle: Price Elasticity of Demand and Supply
questions.keyPoint: Measuring price elasticity of supply
questions.stem: With the rapid development of artificial intelligence, technology companies need more electricity to operate their data centres. As a result, the price of electricity rises by 10% and the quantity transacted changes by 20%. Which of the following best explains the above change in price and quantity transacted of electricity?

choices.text: Electricity is difficult to replace with other goods.
Electricity companies have spare production capacity.
The equipment required to produce electricity is not easy to install.
Electricity is a necessity for consumers.

questions.explanation: The rise in demand raises both price and quantity. Quantity changes by a greater percentage than price, showing elastic supply. Spare production capacity makes electricity supply more elastic.

questions.keyPoint: Analyse the effects of the imposition of (effective) price ceiling on (money) price, quantity transacted, total revenue, etc.
questions.stem: Refer to the following market demand and supply schedules for good X.

choices.text: If the government removes the price ceiling, the total revenue from good X will decrease.
If the government lowers the price ceiling, the deadweight loss will decrease.
If the government replaces the price ceiling with a quota of 24 units, the two measures will have equivalent effect on the price.
If the government replaces the price ceiling with a per-unit tax of $4, the two measures will have equivalent effect on the quantity transacted.

questions.explanation: The original equilibrium is $14 and 26 units. The $12 ceiling gives 24 units. A $4 unit tax also gives 24 units, although buyers pay $16, so only the quantity effect is equivalent.

visuals.caption: Market demand and supply schedules for good X

questions.postVisualStem: Suppose the government sets a price ceiling on good X at $12. Which of the following statements about good X is CORRECT?

questions.keyPoint: State the general features of different market structures
questions.stem:
Which of the following statements about perfect competition is/are CORRECT?

(1) Only price competition exists.
(2) The marginal cost of the last unit of all firms is the same when they maximise their profits.
(3) All firms earn the same profit.
questions.explanation: Perfectly competitive firms sell homogeneous products with perfect information, so price competition exists but non-price competition is unnecessary. Profit maximisation gives MR = MC = market price for every firm, while profits can differ because costs differ.

questions.keyPoint: Analyse the effects of the provision of a unit subsidy on price, quantity transacted, total revenue etc., and show the share of the subsidy between producers and consumers
questions.stem: Refer to the following demand-supply diagram for good X. The initial equilibrium point is E.
questions.explanation: A cheaper substitute lowers demand for X, so the marginal benefit of the last unit falls. A subsidy creates deadweight loss, while the lower demand also reduces consumer and producer surplus, so total social surplus falls.

visuals.alt: Demand-supply diagram for good X with initial equilibrium E.
visuals.caption: Subsidy and a cheaper substitute

movements: A per-unit subsidy shifts supply right.
A fall in the substitute's price shifts demand for X left.
diagramDetails.answerFocus: Both changes lower the marginal benefit of the last unit; the subsidy creates deadweight loss and lower demand reduces surplus, so option D is correct.

questions.postVisualStem: Suppose the government provides a per-unit subsidy for good X, and at the same time, the price of a substitute for good X decreases. The marginal benefit of the last unit of good X will ____________, while the total social surplus will ____________.

questions.chapterTitle: Efficiency, Equity and the Role of Government (I)
questions.topicGroup: With the aid of a demand-supply diagram, analyse the effects of market interventions on consumer surplus, producer surplus and efficiency
questions.keyPoint: Quota
questions.stem: Refer to the following demand-supply diagram for good X. Initially, the quota is set at Q1.
questions.explanation: The price stays P0 and quantity rises from Q1 to Q2. Consumer surplus is zero before and after. Total social surplus rises by abce and total expenditure rises by abQ2Q1.

visuals.alt: Demand-supply diagram with quota supply curves SQ1 and SQ2, price P0, quantities Q1 and Q2, and areas a, b, c and e.
visuals.caption: Quota increase and surplus

movements: The quota is raised from Q1 to Q2 while the price remains P0.
diagramDetails.answerFocus: Total social surplus rises by abce and consumers' total expenditure rises by abQ2Q1; consumer surplus stays zero, so option C is correct.

answerVisuals.alt: Suggested-solution quota diagram adding point f to the original labels.
answerVisuals.caption: Suggested-solution quota diagram

movements: The quota diagram adds point f to the original labels.
diagramDetails.answerFocus: Use point f to identify the required quota-surplus result.

questions.postVisualStem:
The government adjusts the quota of good X from Q1 to Q2. Which of the following statements about good X are

CORRECT?

(1) Consumer surplus increases.
(2) Total social surplus increases by the area abce.
(3) Consumers' total expenditure on good X increases by area abQ2Q1.

questions.chapterTitle: Efficiency, Equity and the Role of Government (II)
questions.keyPoint: Interpret the information delivered from the Gini coefficient
questions.stem: The table below shows Country A's Gini coefficient based on post-tax post-social transfer household income.

choices.text: The incomes of high-income households increased by a greater extent than those of low-income households.
The tax system changed from regressive to progressive.
The proportion of total income earned by the top of 20% households increased.
The government of Country A introduced a general sales tax.

questions.explanation: The Gini coefficient falls from 0.411 to 0.372, so income distribution becomes more equal. A shift from regressive to progressive taxation makes higher-income groups pay a larger income share in tax and can explain the fall.
questions.postVisualStem: Which of the following may explain the change in Country A's Gini coefficient over the above period?

questions.chapterTitle: Efficiency, Equity and the Role of Government (II)
questions.topicGroup: Sources of income inequality including human capital, discrimination, unequal ownership of capital, etc.
questions.keyPoint: Sources of income inequality including human capital, discrimination, unequal ownership of capital, etc.
questions.stem: Which of the following may explain why income inequality among restaurant waiters tends to be smaller than that among real estate agents?

choices.text: The market demand for real estate agents is smaller.
The services provided by real estate agents are more heterogeneous.
Gender discrimination among restaurant waiters is more serious.
Restaurant waiters have a lower level of education.

questions.explanation: Real estate agents differ more in service quality, sales skills and client markets, so their commissions vary much more. Restaurant waiters' incomes are mainly fixed hourly wages with smaller human-capital differences.

questions.keyPoint: Production/value added approach
questions.stem: The following diagram shows a production chain of garments in Country A.

visuals.alt: Garments production chain connecting local materials, local manufacturers, foreign retailers, local retailers, foreign exporters and local consumers.
visuals.caption: Garments production chain

movements: Local manufacturers supply foreign and local retailers.
Foreign exporters supply local retailers.
diagramDetails.answerFocus: Local value added less the $80 sales tax gives GDP at factor cost of $1,250, so option B is correct.

questions.postVisualStem: The contribution of the above production chain to Country A's GDP at factor cost is ________.

questions.keyPoint: Gross national income (Gross national product)
questions.stem: To calculate Hong Kong's gross national income (GNI), which of the following should be deducted from Hong Kong's gross domestic product (GDP)?

choices.text: the rental income earned by a Hong Kong resident from an overseas property he owns
the interest received by a Hong Kong resident from holding bonds of a foreign company
the salary earned by a Mainland professor working at a university in Hong Kong for six months
the salary received by a Korean working in a company in Hong Kong for two years

questions.explanation: GNI subtracts factor income earned by non-residents within Hong Kong. The Mainland professor is a non-resident working in Hong Kong for only six months. The Korean worker is a Hong Kong resident after two years.

questions.keyPoint: Meaning of per capita GDP
questions.stem: The per capita real GDP of a country has increased, but people generally think that their standard of living has declined. Which of the following situations can best explain this phenomenon?

choices.text: There are more unreported economic activities in the country.
The inflation rate of the country has risen.
The population of the country has increased.
The income distribution of the country has become more uneven.

questions.explanation: Per capita real GDP already removes price-level and population changes. A more uneven distribution can let a small group consume more while most people experience a lower living standard.

questions.keyPoint: Analyse changes in money demand, money supply and nominal interest rate
questions.stem: The diagram below shows the money supply curve (Ms) and money demand curve (Md) of an economy. Suppose the initial equilibrium point is at E.

choices.text: may increase, decrease or remain unchanged ... will increase
may increase, decrease or remain unchanged ... will decrease

questions.explanation: Remittances raise money supply and increase quantity of money. Higher stock-market volatility raises asset demand for money. The two shifts have opposite effects on the nominal interest rate, so its final change is uncertain.

visuals.alt: Money-market diagram with vertical money supply Ms and downward money demand Md meeting at E.
visuals.caption: Money-market shifts

movements: Overseas companies remitting money shifts Ms right.
Greater stock-market volatility shifts asset demand for money right.
diagramDetails.answerFocus: The money quantity rises, while the interest-rate effects conflict, so option C is correct.

questions.postVisualStem: Suppose more overseas companies remit money to the economy's banking system and the volatility of the stock market increases. In this case, the nominal interest rate ___________, and the quantity of money ___________.

questions.topicGroup: Factors affecting short run aggregate supply
questions.keyPoint: Factors affecting short run aggregate supply
questions.stem: Which of the following would be most likely to cause the price level of an economy to fall in the short run?

choices.text: The price of raw materials decreases, and a major trading partner of the economy experiences an economic recession.
Labour productivity increases, and the government carries out an open market purchase of government bonds.
People's desire to save decreases, and the economy's currency appreciates.
The required reserve ratio decreases, and a major natural disaster occurs that disrupts production.

questions.explanation: Cheaper raw materials shift SRAS right and a trading partner's recession reduces net exports and shifts AD left. Both changes lower the price level. Each other option combines effects that offset or raise the price level.

questions.topicGroup: Deviations of short run equilibrium from long run equilibrium
questions.keyPoint: Inflationary gap
questions.stem: The diagram below shows the aggregate demand curve, short run aggregate supply curve and long run aggregate supply curve for an economy.

choices.text: In the long run, the price level will be lower than P0.
In the long run, the full-employment output level will rise to Y0.
A reduction in the profits tax rate will help restore the output level to the full-employment output level.
Through the market adjustment mechanism, the short run aggregate supply will decrease and the output level will be restored to the full-employment output level.

questions.explanation: Y0 is above the full-employment output Yf, so there is an inflationary output gap. Rising input prices shift SRAS left until output returns to Yf, at a price level above P0.

visuals.alt: AS-AD diagram with AD, SRAS and LRAS, output Y0 above full-employment output Yf, and price P0.
visuals.caption: Inflationary output gap

movements: At Y0 above Yf, upward pressure on input prices shifts SRAS left in the long run.
diagramDetails.answerFocus: Market adjustment decreases SRAS and restores output to Yf, so option D is correct.

questions.postVisualStem: Which of the following descriptions is CORRECT?

questions.topicGroup: Factors affecting long run aggregate supply
questions.keyPoint: Factors affecting long run aggregate supply
questions.stem: Suppose the government of Country A relaxes the restrictions on importing foreign labour to fill job vacancies in the market. Some foreign workers bring their family members to live in Country A. Which of the following diagrams best describes the effect of the above event?
questions.explanation: More foreign workers raise productive capacity, shifting LRAS right. The workers and their families also raise private consumption, shifting AD right. Diagram C shows both changes.

visuals.alt: Four AS-AD option diagrams A to D for importing foreign labour and accompanying family members.
visuals.caption: Foreign labour and aggregate demand/supply

movements: More foreign labour increases productive capacity and shifts LRAS right.
Workers and family members raise consumption and shift AD right.
diagramDetails.answerFocus: Option C is the only diagram showing both a rightward LRAS shift and a rightward AD shift.

questions.keyPoint: Qualities of good money
questions.stem:
Diamonds are better than rice in performing the __________ function of money because the former has a higher ____________.

(1) medium of exchange ... divisibility
(2) store of value ... durability
(3) unit of account ... homogeneity
questions.explanation: Diamonds are more durable than rice and therefore better as a store of value. Rice is more divisible, while both goods can be homogeneous enough for the stated comparison.

questions.keyPoint: Definitions of M1, M2 and M3 in
questions.stem:
Miss Tai withdraws HK$200,000 cash from a deposit-taking company. She then uses $50,000 cash to purchase a negotiable certificate of deposit issued by a licensed bank and remits the remaining amount overseas.

What will be the immediate effect of the above actions on the money supply of Hong Kong?

choices.text: Money supply M1 will remain unchanged.
Money supply M1 and M2 will both remain unchanged.
Money supply M3 will decrease by HK$200,000.
Money supply M2 and M3 will both decrease by HK$150,000.

questions.explanation: The first withdrawal raises M1 and M2 by $200,000; buying the licensed-bank negotiable certificate lowers M1 by $50,000; remitting $150,000 overseas lowers all measures by $150,000. Overall M1 is unchanged, M2 rises by $50,000 and M3 falls by $150,000.

questions.keyPoint: Understand and calculate maximum and actual banking multipliers
questions.stem: Refer to the following balance sheet of the banking system of an economy. The banking system has excess reserves of $100 million.
questions.explanation: Required reserves are $200 million, so the reserve ratio is 20%. After the withdrawal, reserves are $250 million. Fully loaned-up deposits become $250 / 20% = $1,250 million and loans become $1,000 million, which is option A.
questions.postVisualStem: Suppose someone withdraws $50 million from the banking system and holds it as cash. If the banking system is fully loaned up and there is no cash leakage, which of the following will be its new balance sheet?

questions.chapterTitle: Business Cycle, Changes in the General Price Level and Unemployment
questions.keyPoint: Features of the four phases of a business cycle
questions.stem: Refer to the following diagram.

choices.text: Government revenue from salaries tax increases.

questions.explanation: At A, real GDP growth is falling and below zero, indicating recession. Consumption, investment, firm sales, household income and salaries-tax revenue tend to fall, so import volume decreases.

visuals.alt: Business-cycle diagram showing percentage change in real GDP, average growth rate and point A below zero.
visuals.caption: Business-cycle position

movements: At A, the real-GDP growth rate is falling and below zero.
diagramDetails.answerFocus: The economy is in recession, so firm sales and imports fall; option C is correct.

questions.postVisualStem: When an economy is operating at point A, which of the following economic phenomena is most likely to occur?

questions.chapterTitle: Business Cycle, Changes in the General Price Level and Unemployment
questions.keyPoint: Effects of inflation and deflation on different aspects
questions.stem: If there is unexpected inflation, which of the following persons will gain?

choices.text: a businessman who holds a time deposit in a bank
a secondary school student who keeps red packet money at home
an investor who rents out a residential unit at a fixed rent
a consumer who pays a fixed monthly fee for a video streaming service

questions.explanation: Unexpected inflation lowers the real value of fixed payments. The consumer benefits because the fixed streaming fee is worth less in real terms; fixed-interest recipients, cash holders and fixed-rent receivers lose.

questions.chapterTitle: Business Cycle, Changes in the General Price Level and Unemployment
questions.topicGroup: Relationship between nominal and real interest rates
questions.keyPoint: Understand the equation: nominal interest rate = real interest rate + expected inflation rate
questions.explanation: The opportunity cost of holding money is the nominal interest rate, 2%. Cash has a nominal return of zero, so its actual real rate of return is 0% - 7% = -7%.
questions.postVisualStem: Based on the above information, the cost of holding money is __________ and the actual real rate of return on holding money is __________.

questions.keyPoint: Progressive tax, proportional tax and regressive tax
questions.stem: The following diagram shows the relationship between
questions.explanation: The curve is regressive because tax payment rises less than proportionately with taxable income. It makes income distribution more uneven and violates the equity principle. Taxable income is already after allowances, so the allowance cannot be determined.

visuals.alt: Tax-payment curve that rises at a decreasing rate as taxable income rises.
visuals.caption: Regressive tax schedule

movements: Tax payment rises less than proportionately as taxable income rises.
diagramDetails.answerFocus: The schedule is regressive and tends to make income distribution more uneven; taxable income does not reveal the allowance, so option A is correct.

questions.postVisualStem:
taxable income and tax payment in a tax system.

Which of the following statements about the above tax system is/are CORRECT?

(1) The tax system is in line with the equity principle of taxation put forward by Adam Smith.
(2) The tax leads to a more uneven income distribution.
(3) The tax allowance of the tax system is zero.

questions.chapterTitle: Balance of Payments Account and Exchange Rate
questions.topicGroup: Balance of payments and balance of the BOP account
questions.keyPoint: Meaning of balance of payment surplus and deficit
questions.stem: Suppose there are a fiscal surplus and a trade deficit in an economy. Which of the following may increase the fiscal surplus and reduce the trade deficit?

choices.text: The government introduces a general sales tax.
The government increases the quota for importing foreign labour.
The government imposes a tariff on imported goods.

questions.explanation: A tariff raises government revenue and makes imports more expensive, reducing import volume. It can therefore raise the fiscal surplus and reduce the trade deficit.

questions.keyPoint: Expansionary and contractionary monetary policy, including changes in required reserve ratio and discount rate
questions.stem: Which of the following is an example of a contractionary monetary policy?

choices.text: a reduction in the basic allowance for the salaries tax
an increase in loan interest rates by commercial banks
a reduction in the discount rate
an open market sale of government bonds by the central bank

questions.explanation: An open market sale of government bonds by the central bank reduces the money supply, which is contractionary monetary policy. Salaries-tax allowance is fiscal policy, commercial banks are not the central bank, and a lower discount rate is expansionary.

questions.keyPoint: Expansionary and contractionary monetary policy, including changes in required reserve ratio and discount rate
questions.stem: Suppose the government lowers the required reserve ratio of the banking system. Which of the following would weaken the effect of the above policy on the price level in the short run?

choices.text: lowering the standard tax rate of the salaries tax
removing tariff exemptions for imported goods
tightening the criteria for receiving unemployment benefits

questions.explanation: A lower reserve ratio raises money supply, aggregate demand and the price level. Tighter unemployment-benefit criteria reduce disposable income and consumption, shifting AD left and offsetting the policy.

questions.keyPoint: Analyse changes in money demand, money supply and nominal interest rate
questions.stem: Suppose the risk of holding bonds in Country A increases. Which of the following can offset the effects of the above event on Country A's output level and nominal interest rate in the short run?

choices.text: The government increases the allowance for the salaries tax.
The government raises the required reserve ratio.
More enterprises extend the income payment interval.
Electronic payment methods become more popular in the market.

questions.explanation: Greater bond risk raises asset demand for money, increasing interest rates and reducing output. More electronic payments lower transaction demand for money, lowering interest rates and raising consumption and investment, offsetting both effects.

questions.keyPoint: Explain which country has a comparative advantage in the production of a good in a given case
questions.stem: The following table shows the labour requirement for the production of pears and rice in Country A and Country B respectively.
questions.explanation: Country A uses more labour for pears, so it lacks absolute advantage. Its opportunity cost of rice is 1.5 pears compared with 3 pears in B, so A has comparative advantage in rice. Mutually beneficial terms require 1 rice to trade for between 1.5 and 3 pears.
questions.postVisualStem:
Based on the above table, which of the following statements is/are CORRECT?

(1) Country A has an absolute advantage in producing pears.
(2) Country A has a comparative advantage in producing rice.
(3) 1 unit of pears = 1 unit of rice is a mutually beneficial terms of trade for the two countries.

questions.keyPoint: Analyse the effects of a quota on domestic price, domestic consumption, domestic production and import quantity for a small open economy
questions.stem: Below is the supply-demand diagram for good X in a small open economy. S0 is the domestic supply curve of good X and S1 is the supply curve after an import quota is imposed.

choices.text: The domestic price of good X will decrease.
The increase in import volume will be (Q4 - Q3).
The domestic production of good X will decrease.
Consumers' total expenditure on good X will remain unchanged.

questions.explanation: The quota remains binding after the world price falls. Domestic price remains P1, domestic output remains Q2, imports remain Q3 - Q2, and quantity transacted remains Q3, so total expenditure is unchanged.

visuals.alt: Small-open-economy import-quota diagram with S0, quota supply S1, demand D, international price P0, domestic price P1 and quantities Q1 to Q4.
visuals.caption: Binding import quota

movements: A lower international price remains below the quota-determined domestic price.
The binding quota fixes domestic price, domestic output and import volume.
diagramDetails.answerFocus: Price and quantity transacted remain P1 and Q3, so consumers' total expenditure remains unchanged; option D is correct.

answerVisuals.alt: Suggested-solution import-quota diagram showing the lower international price P2.
answerVisuals.caption: Suggested-solution import-quota diagram

movements: The international price falls to P2 under the quota setting.
diagramDetails.answerFocus: Identify the new import quantity and welfare implication at P2.

questions.postVisualStem: Suppose the international price of good X decreases. Which of the following is CORRECT?

questions.chapterTitle: Balance of Payments Account and Exchange Rate
questions.topicGroup: Current account (main components: goods, services, income and current transfers)
questions.keyPoint: Meaning of current account surplus and deficit
questions.stem: The diagram below shows trade data for economy A from 2018 to 2022.
questions.explanation: The invisible trade balance equals service exports minus service imports. From 2018 to 2019, exports rise while imports fall, so the surplus widens. In every later interval, the stated combination fails.

visuals.alt: Line chart of exports and imports of services for economy A from 2018 to 2022.
visuals.caption: Services trade data

movements: From 2018 to 2019, service exports increase while service imports decrease.
diagramDetails.answerFocus: The invisible trade surplus widens only from 2018 to 2019 while service exports rise, so option A is correct.

questions.postVisualStem: From __________ to __________ , economy A had an increase in the value of exports of services and an increase in the invisible trade surplus at the same time.

questions.chapterTitle: Balance of Payments Account and Exchange Rate
questions.topicGroup: Brief introduction to the linked exchange rate system in
questions.keyPoint: Brief introduction to the linked exchange rate system in
questions.stem: Under the linked exchange rate system in Hong Kong, which of the following statements is CORRECT?

choices.text: The market exchange rate of the Hong Kong dollar against the US dollar is fixed.
The money supply of Hong Kong is fully backed by the US dollar.
The Hong Kong Monetary Authority can exchange Hong Kong dollars for US dollars with the public at the linked exchange rate.
There will be inflationary pressure in Hong Kong when the US dollar continuously depreciates against the renminbi.

questions.explanation: The Hong Kong dollar depreciates with the US dollar against the renminbi, making Mainland imports more expensive in Hong Kong dollars and creating inflationary pressure. The market exchange rate is not fixed, only the monetary base is fully backed, and only note-issuing banks transact with the HKMA at the linked rate.

questions.keyPoint: 稀少性、競爭及歧視的關係
questions.stem: 一個存在稀少性的社會意味着以下哪項？
questions.explanation: 稀少性迫使人們作選擇；每個選擇都有機會成本，亦會引起對稀少資源的競爭。稀少性本身不必然意味着交換。

questions.topicGroup: 利息作為提早獲得資 源的成本或代價
questions.keyPoint: 利息的意思
questions.stem: 利息

choices.text: 是提早消費所付出的代價。
可能在一個沒有交換的社會出現。
只存在於貨幣經濟體系。

questions.explanation: 利息是為提早取得資源或消費而付出的代價。即使沒有貨幣或交換，仍可能存在利息。

questions.keyPoint: 稀少性的意思
questions.stem: 稀少性

choices.text: 存在於經濟物品和免費物品。
在人們的慾望是無限的情況下必定存在。
在一人經濟中並不存在。
是一切經濟問題的根源。

questions.explanation: 資源不足以滿足所有慾望會產生稀少性，因而引起基本經濟問題。慾望無限本身並不足以保證存在稀少性。

questions.keyPoint: 解釋在不同情況下成本如何改變
questions.stem: 莉莉正在考慮購買一台手提電腦或桌上電腦。以下哪項會令莉莉購買手提電腦的成本改變？

choices.text: 她想要的手提電腦的電池很快耗盡。
許多種類的軟件不能安裝在她想要的手提電腦。
莉莉想要的桌上電腦的效能不如生產商所聲稱的水平。
莉莉的叔父準備送一台手提電腦給她作為生日禮物。

questions.explanation: 選擇手提電腦的成本是所放棄的最佳選項的價值。桌上電腦的效能變差會改變該替代選項的價值，因而改變機會成本。

questions.keyPoint: 稀少性、競爭及歧視的關係
questions.stem: 稀少性意味着

choices.text: 所有物品的市場價格必定很高。

questions.explanation: 稀少性使資源不能滿足所有慾望，分配時會出現競爭和歧視；它不必然要求專門化或所有物品價格很高。

questions.keyPoint: 識別及計算選擇一個選項時涉及的成本（顯性成本及隱含成本）
questions.stem: 在甲戲院，觀眾每購買一張戲票，便可得到一個印花。印花可換取下列的禮品：

choices.text: 4罐可樂、1部菲林相機及一部手提電話

questions.explanation: 20 個印花可換取四罐可樂、一部菲林相機或兩張戲票；手提電話還需要支付 $1,000。因此，所放棄的最佳選項是四罐可樂。
questions.postVisualStem: 曉彤擁有20個印花。曉彤以20個印花換取2張戲票的機會成本是甚麼？

questions.keyPoint: 免費物品及經濟物品的定義
questions.stem:
以下哪幾項關於物品的描述是正確的？

(1) 沒有人想要任何免費物品。
(2) 天然資源都是免費物品。
(3) 免費的物品可能是經濟物品。
(4) 在不同的情況下，一種物品有可能被視為免費物品或經濟物品。
questions.explanation: 免費物品仍可被人想要，只是其數量足以滿足慾望。免費派發的樣本亦可能是經濟物品；同一物品的稀少程度可因時間和地點而不同。

questions.keyPoint: 區分免費物品及經濟物品
questions.stem: 經濟學上，在撒哈拉沙漠的雨水屬於__________，因為__________。

choices.text: 經濟物品……在沙漠中只有少量的雨水
免費物品……人們不用付出成本也能得到它們
經濟物品……人們都希望得到更多
免費物品……它沒有其他用途

questions.explanation: 撒哈拉沙漠的雨水相對於人們的慾望是稀少的，人們希望得到更多，故屬經濟物品。是否付款或有否其他用途不是分類準則。

questions.keyPoint: 稀少性和選擇的關係
questions.stem: 以下哪項關於選擇的描述是正確的？

choices.text: 稀少性不存在時，人們仍然需要作出選擇。
當只有一個選項時，人們仍然需要決定是否選取該選項。
當選項多於一個時，某人選擇其中一個選項的成本是其餘選項的價值的總和。
當資源和慾望都有限時，人們仍可能需要作出選擇。

questions.explanation: 即使資源及慾望均有限，只要資源不足以同時滿足相關慾望，仍要作選擇。選擇的成本是所放棄的最高價值選項，而不是所有餘下選項的總和。

questions.keyPoint: 成本的定義
questions.stem: 以下哪項是在香港興建一個主題公園的成本？

choices.text: 興建公園時所產生的噪音污染

questions.explanation: 建築期間的噪音污染是實際成本。入場費是收入，而維修及招聘費用是在興建決定之後才出現。

questions.keyPoint: 以循環流程模型解釋為何本地生產總值能以三個層面計算
questions.stem: 以下是某經濟體系的循環流程模型。

choices.text: 住戶消費開支……生產要素
生產成本……最終物品和服務
生產要素收入……生產要素
廠商收入……最終物品和服務

questions.explanation: 由住戶流向廠商的貨幣流程是住戶消費開支；相應由住戶流向廠商的實質流程是生產要素。

visuals.alt: 循環流程圖，顯示廠商、住戶、流程 X、流程 Y、貨幣流程及實質流程。
visuals.caption: 經濟體系的循環流程模型

movements: 流程 X 是住戶的消費開支流向廠商的貨幣流程。
流程 Y 是住戶提供生產要素予廠商的實質流程。
diagramDetails.answerFocus: 選項 A 正確識別流程 X 為住戶消費開支，流程 Y 為生產要素。

questions.postVisualStem: 流程 X 代表了__________的流動，而流程 Y 代表了__________的流動。

questions.chapterTitle: 三個基本經濟問題與私有產權
questions.keyPoint: 交換是專門化的一個條件
questions.stem: 假如交換不存在，實行專門化後，

choices.text: 經濟體系內每個人都有更高的生活水平。
人們不用生產所有他們需要的物品。
人們可以較低的機會成本生產物品。

questions.explanation: 專門化使人們可集中生產機會成本較低的物品。沒有交換時，人們不能透過交易取得其他所需物品，故其餘結論不成立。

questions.topicGroup: 區分實證性陳述和規範性陳述
questions.keyPoint: 區分實證性陳述和規範性陳述
questions.stem: 一項規範性陳述
questions.explanation: 規範性陳述包含價值判斷，不能單憑事實證實或推翻。

questions.chapterTitle: 三個基本經濟問題與私有產權
questions.keyPoint: 三個基本經濟問題的意思及相關例子
questions.stem: 甲國政府計劃生產更多坦克以增強國防能力。這與哪(幾)個基本經濟問題有關？
questions.explanation: 決定生產更多坦克是決定產出種類及數量，屬於「生產甚麼」的問題。

questions.chapterTitle: 三個基本經濟問題與私有產權
questions.keyPoint: 不同社會解決基本經濟問題的方法
questions.stem: 與市場經濟比較，指令經濟

choices.text: 有更多的資源由政府擁有。
有更多的生產活動由價格信號所指導。

questions.explanation: 指令經濟較依賴政府擁有資源及中央計劃；其餘選項均不是必然特徵。

questions.chapterTitle: 三個基本經濟問題與私有產權
questions.keyPoint: 不同社會解決基本經濟問題的方法
questions.stem:
在香港，以下哪些物品的的資源分配主要由價格信號指導？

(1) 稻米
(2) 食水供應
(3) 汽油
(4) 電力供應
questions.explanation: 稻米及汽油主要透過市場價格分配；食水及電力供應有較多政府提供或規管。

questions.chapterTitle: 三個基本經濟問題與私有產權
questions.keyPoint: 不同社會解決基本經濟問題的方法
questions.stem:
以下哪幾項很大程度上決定了計劃經濟的物品和服務的分配？

(1) 消費者的需求
(2) 政府計劃
(3) 消費者的購買力
questions.explanation: 在計劃經濟中，物品和服務主要由政府計劃分配，而非由消費者需求或購買力決定。

questions.chapterTitle: 三個基本經濟問題與私有產權
questions.keyPoint: 私有產權的意思和在市場經濟中的重要性
questions.stem: 以下哪項關於私有產權的描述是正確的？

choices.text: 計劃經濟完全沒有私有產權。
假如私有產權沒有受到良好保護，人們可能不會進行交易。
當某人擁有某物品的轉讓權，他或她便必定擁有該物品的獨有私用權和收入專屬權。
當私有產權的定義明確時，便不需要競爭物品和服務。

questions.explanation: 受到保障的私有產權有助人們放心持有及轉讓物品，從而鼓勵交易。私有產權不會消除稀少性或競爭。

questions.keyPoint: 比較不同所有權形式的特徵及利弊
questions.stem: 當一間廠商從股票市場除牌，

choices.text: 它賺取盈利的能力會被削弱。
若現有股東的人數多於200人，它便必須削減股東的人數。

questions.explanation: 除牌後公司仍可保持獨立法人和私下發行股份。私人有限公司的股東數目上限為 200 人，超出時必須削減。

questions.keyPoint: 私人廠商的分類：獨資、合夥、私人有限公司及公眾有限公司
questions.stem: 東尼是香港一間會計師樓的其中一位合夥人。以下哪項是正確的？

choices.text: 東尼的債務責任並不限於他在會計師樓所投資的金額。
他需要與其他合夥人均分利潤。
該會計師樓可能是一間私人有限公司。
東尼可控告該會計師樓。

questions.explanation: 合夥人的債務責任一般是無限的。利潤比例由合夥協議決定；合夥並非可由合夥人控告的獨立法人。

questions.keyPoint: 比較不同所有權形式的特徵及利弊
questions.stem: __________籌集資金的途徑最少。
questions.explanation: 獨資東主主要依靠個人資金、借款及保留盈利；各類公司可透過股東及證券等較多途徑籌集資金。

questions.keyPoint: 比較不同所有權形式的特徵及利弊
questions.stem:
如果廠商是____________，廠商的東主便可控告自己的廠商。

(1) 獨資
(2) 合夥
(3) 私人有限公司
(4) 公眾有限公司
questions.explanation: 私人有限公司及公眾有限公司均為獨立法人，故東主可控告公司；獨資及合夥則不是。

questions.topicGroup: 股票及債券作為資金來源
questions.keyPoint: 從小投資者的角度出發，購買股票及債券的優點和缺點
questions.stem: 作為一個小投資者，詠欣傾向選擇購買公眾有限公司的股票而不是私人有限公司的股票。這可能是因為

choices.text: 她想公司的擁有權轉讓較容易。
她想享有較高的回報率。
她想享有有限債務責任。

questions.explanation: 公眾有限公司的股份一般較容易在股票市場轉讓。有限債務責任及控告公司的權利均可見於兩類有限公司。

questions.topicGroup: 股票及債券作為資金來源
questions.keyPoint: 發行股票及債券籌集資金的優點和缺點
questions.stem: 以下哪一個籌集資金的途徑會降低公司保留盈利作將來發展之用的靈活性？
questions.explanation: 普通股股東可能期望公司從盈利派發股息，因而減低公司保留盈利的靈活性。

questions.keyPoint: 比較不同所有權形式的特徵及利弊
questions.stem: 以下哪項是一間廠商由獨資轉為私人有限公司的可能動機？

choices.text: 擁有者可透過引入新股東籌集資金。
廠商的財務狀況得以保密。
廠商的股票可在股票市場交易。

questions.explanation: 私人有限公司可引入新股東籌集資金，但其股份不可在股票市場公開交易，改變形式亦不必然降低利得稅率。

questions.keyPoint: 私人廠商的分類：獨資、合夥、私人有限公司及公眾有限公司
questions.stem: 參考下表。

choices.text: 公眾有限公司……私人有限公司
沒有足夠的資料得到答案。

questions.explanation: 只有東主數目和有限債務責任不足以判定廠商形式。甲可是一人私人有限公司，乙則可為私人或公眾有限公司。

visuals.caption: 廠商的東主及債務責任

questions.keyPoint: 三類生產的意思及例子；辨別生產的種類
questions.stem: 生產

choices.text: 指的是將天然資源轉化為產出的過程。
不一定會帶來金錢上的回報。
幫助解決稀少性的問題。

questions.explanation: 生產是創造效用的活動，可以包括沒有金錢回報的服務。它不必只轉化天然資源或涉及多於一間廠商，亦不能消除稀少性。

questions.keyPoint: 生產者物品及消費品
questions.stem:
以下哪(幾)項關於生產者物品和消費者物品的描述是正確的？

(1) 一種物品可以是生產者物品或服務，視乎人們如何運用它。
(2) 消費者物品可直接滿足人類的慾望，生產者物品則不能。
(3) 生產者物品和消費者物品都一定是私用品。
questions.explanation: 物品屬生產者物品或消費者物品取決於用途；消費者物品直接滿足慾望，生產者物品是生產投入。兩者不一定都是私用品。

questions.keyPoint: 私用品及共用品
questions.stem: 私用品

choices.text: 是用於生產其他物品和服務的物品。
一經生產後，提供予多一位消費者的額外成本仍是正數。

questions.explanation: 私用品具有競爭性及排他性；供應給多一位消費者的邊際成本為正或會減少其他人的可用量。

questions.keyPoint: 三類生產的意思及例子；辨別生產的種類
questions.stem: 下表顯示了三個國家在某一年的就業分布情況。

choices.text: 以就業情況而言，乙國和丙國最大的生產部門是三級生產部門。
乙國三級生產的就業人數最大。
相對於乙國和丙國，甲國的發展較落後。
甲國二級生產對本地生產總值的貢獻最大。

questions.explanation: 乙國和丙國的三級生產就業比例均最大。百分比資料不能比較實際就業人數、國家發展程度或各部門對本地生產總值的貢獻。
questions.postVisualStem: 從上表所見，我們可以斷定

questions.keyPoint: 分工的好處及壞處
questions.stem:
以下哪幾項是實行分工的好處？

(1) 勞工生產力上升。
(2) 勞工的職業流動性上升。
(3) 生產工具得以更充分利用。
(4) 機器可用以取代工人。
questions.explanation: 分工可提高勞工生產力，並使專門化的生產工具更充分使用。它可能降低職業流動性，而機器取代工人不是分工必然帶來的好處。

questions.keyPoint: 分工的好處及壞處
questions.stem: 實施分工後，

choices.text: 只有生產力最高的工人會被雇用。
工人的訓練時間得以縮短。
轉換工作崗位所需時間增加。

questions.explanation: 工人專責較狹窄的工作，訓練時間可縮短，亦會節省而非增加轉換工作崗位的時間。

questions.keyPoint: 天然資源：土地
questions.stem: 以下哪項應被分類為「土地」？
questions.explanation: 土地是天然資源。熱帶雨林內的樹木自然存在；經施肥土壤及種雲雨水包含人力投入，而農田已被生產活動改造。

questions.keyPoint: 人造資源：資本
questions.stem: 經濟學上，一間房子被分類為_________，而由出租房子所得的回報被分類為__________。
questions.explanation: 房子是人造資源，用於提供住屋服務，屬資本；資本的回報是利息。

questions.keyPoint: 人造資源：資本
questions.stem: 以下哪項是土地和資本相異之處？

choices.text: 資本經過人力加工，而土地沒有。
資本可以增加，而土地的數量是固定的。
運用資本涉及成本，而使用土地是沒有成本的。
資本有職業流動性，而土地則沒有。

questions.explanation: 資本由人力製造，土地則是天然資源。其餘選項並非土地與資本普遍而必然的分別。

questions.keyPoint: 勞力供應
questions.stem: 以下哪一項事件不會令香港的勞力供應改變？

choices.text: 很多人因為金融風暴而計劃延遲退休

questions.explanation: 失業率下降改變的是受僱勞工的數量，而非勞力供應。其餘事件會改變人們可供應或願意供應的勞力。

questions.keyPoint: 勞工生產力
questions.stem: 參考下表。

visuals.caption: 廠商的工人、工時及產出

questions.postVisualStem: 如果兩間廠商的工人的生產力都相同，X與Y之比率為

questions.keyPoint: 不同的付酬方式
questions.stem: 假設某旅行社的導遊計算薪金的方法，由傳統的「底薪加佣金」制度轉為以公司利潤的某個百分比計算。以下哪項是可能的後果？

choices.text: 監察導遊表現的成本上升
導遊提供的服務的質素改善
旅行社的東主承擔的經營風險上升

questions.explanation: 薪金與公司利潤掛鈎，會鼓勵導遊改善服務及協助提升公司整體表現；其收入和東主風險不一定按選項所述方向改變。

questions.keyPoint: 勞力的流動性
questions.stem: 如果_________，那麼香港的勞工的地域流動性會上升。

choices.text: 政府推行大規模的再培訓計劃
港鐵公司降低所有路線的票價
收緊入境政策令移居香港變得困難
一些廠商向居住於偏遠地區的員工提供房屋津貼

questions.explanation: 交通費下降會降低勞工往返不同居住地和工作地的成本，從而提高地域流動性。再培訓主要影響職業流動性。

questions.keyPoint: 勞力的流動性
questions.stem: 下列哪項職業的地域流動性最低？

choices.text: 沒有足夠的資料得到答案

questions.explanation: 地域流動性取決於交通、住屋和職位空缺等情況，不能單憑職業名稱比較高低。

questions.keyPoint: 稀少性的意思
questions.stem: 稀少性的存在意味着

choices.text: 貧窮和富裕的人都不能滿足他們所有的慾望。
人們必須以價格競爭來分配資源。
人們不是在以物易物的經濟體系中。

questions.explanation: 稀少性是可用資源不足以滿足所有慾望，與個人貧富無關；它不必然要求價格競爭或排除以物易物。

questions.keyPoint: 識別及計算選擇一個選項時涉及的成本（顯性成本及隱含成本）
questions.stem:
李小姐是一名銀行經理。最近她向銀行申請了兩星期的無薪假期，與家人到澳洲度假。以下哪項應包括在她這次旅行的成本中？

(1) 往返香港至澳洲的來回機票的支出
(2) 放棄兩星期的薪金
(3) 李小姐在澳洲的醫療開支
questions.explanation: 機票和醫療開支是顯性成本，放棄的薪金是隱含成本，三者均構成這次旅行的全成本。

questions.keyPoint: 成本的定義
questions.stem: 香港政府正式批准興建廣深港高速鐵路(高鐵)的香港段，以下哪項不會影響香港興建高鐵的成本？

choices.text: 新界一些受影響的居民要求政府增加賠償金額。
建築工程會破壞鐵路沿線的自然環境。
高鐵的收費昂貴，故此很少人選擇乘搭。

questions.explanation: 賠償、環境破壞及建築工資均屬建造成本；日後車費影響乘客需求，不影響興建成本。

questions.topicGroup: 利息作為提早獲得資 源的成本或代價
questions.keyPoint: 利息的意思
questions.stem: 人們願意付出利息以提早得到物品，這意味着

choices.text: 提早獲得物品與延遲獲得物品的成本相同。
正值的時間偏好程度愈低，愈願意成為借款人。
有些人願意推遲消費以獲得補償。
所有物品都是經濟物品。

questions.explanation: 借出者願意延遲消費以獲取利息補償；借款人通常有較高的正值時間偏好。

questions.keyPoint: 區分免費物品及經濟物品
questions.stem: 以下哪項最接近經濟學上的免費物品？

choices.text: 在互聯網上供免費收看的電影

questions.explanation: 免費物品的數量足以滿足慾望。太平洋海水最接近這個情況；免費電影、樂隊歌聲及空氣都可能是稀少或有使用限制的物品。

questions.keyPoint: 識別及計算選擇一個選項時涉及的成本（顯性成本及隱含成本）
questions.stem: 以下是小達想購買的物品：

choices.text: 一對波鞋及一部計算機

questions.explanation: $500 只足夠購買手錶、波鞋或計算機。買手錶時放棄的最高喜好選項是波鞋。
questions.postVisualStem: 若小達只有$500零用錢，哪項是他選擇購買一隻手錶的機會成本？

questions.chapterTitle: 三個基本經濟問題與私有產權
questions.keyPoint: 不同社會解決基本經濟問題的方法
questions.stem: 香港是混合經濟，例如香港的公共房屋的租金由 __________ 決定，而互聯網服務的收費由 __________ 決定。

choices.text: 社會習俗 …… 市場機制
市場機制 …… 地區分佈

questions.explanation: 公共房屋租金主要由政府決定；互聯網服務收費主要由市場機制決定。

questions.chapterTitle: 三個基本經濟問題與私有產權
questions.keyPoint: 私有產權的意思和在市場經濟中的重要性
questions.stem: 淑芬是學校電腦學會的會長。每天她都會留在電腦室做功課，並協助維持電腦室的秩序。以下哪項最有可能是她擁有的私有財產？

choices.text: 一名學生在電腦室遺下的電子遊戲機
她在電腦室內使用的電腦
她買來做功課的原子筆
她用來紀錄同學名字的筆記簿

questions.explanation: 原子筆由淑芬購買及擁有。遺下的遊戲機屬另一位學生，電腦及紀錄同學名字的筆記簿均不一定是她的私有財產。

questions.keyPoint: 比較不同所有權形式的特徵及利弊

choices.text: 甲廠商和乙廠商都不是上市公司。
乙廠商可以發行股票來籌集資金，而甲廠商不能。
甲廠商的利得稅稅率較乙廠商的高。
只要有一位東主破產，兩間廠商都要解散。

questions.explanation: 甲是可自由轉讓擁有權的獨立法人，乙不是獨立法人。有限公司和非有限公司的利得稅率不同，故 C 正確；其餘結論不能由資料推出。
questions.postVisualStem: 根據上表的資料，以下哪一項是正確的？

questions.keyPoint: 比較不同所有權形式的特徵及利弊
questions.stem:
與有限公司比較，獨資享有

(1) 較簡單的開業手續。
(2) 較大的自主權。
(3) 較多的資金來源。
(4) 較低的利得稅稅率。
questions.explanation: 獨資開業手續較簡單，東主自主權較大，通常適用較低的非公司利得稅率；其資金來源則較少。

questions.keyPoint: 私用品及共用品
questions.stem: 以下哪一項關於共用品的描述是不正確的？

choices.text: 共用品不一定免費提供予使用者。
即使某物品不能同一時間供所有使用者共用而不影響質量，它仍可能是共用品。
向共同品的使用者收費的成本可能很高。
共用品的使用者愈多，提供予額外使用者的成本便愈高。

questions.explanation: 共用品具非競爭性，服務額外使用者的邊際成本為零或很低，故 D 不正確。

questions.keyPoint: 分工的好處及壞處
questions.stem: 小美、志玲和家輝共同經營一所咖啡室，並根據自己的專長，在咖啡室分別擔當不同的工作：小美負責招待客人，志玲負責製作飲料，家輝則負責烹調食物。以下哪一項描述是正確的？

choices.text: 該咖啡室實施了簡單分工。
該咖啡室生產消費品和生產者物品。
以上的工作安排可提高他們的生產力。

questions.explanation: 按專長分工屬複雜分工，可提高生產力。烹調食物是二級生產，咖啡室產出為消費品。

questions.keyPoint: 天然資源：土地
questions.stem: 馬來西亞熱帶雨林中的樹木屬於 ____________，而香港公園所種植的樹木屬於 ____________。

choices.text: 生產者物品 …… 免費物品
共用品 …… 消費者物品

questions.explanation: 熱帶雨林樹木是天然資源，屬土地；香港公園的樹木包含種植及維護的人力投入，屬資本。

questions.keyPoint: 勞力的流動性
questions.stem: 哪項政府政策不能提高勞工的流動性？

choices.text: 向住在偏遠地區的居民提供車資補助
注資持續進修基金，以鼓勵市民學習新技能

questions.explanation: 車資補助和鐵路可提高地域流動性，進修可提高職業流動性；最低工資法不直接提高兩者。

questions.topicGroup: 短期投入與產出的關係
questions.keyPoint: 邊際回報遞減定律
questions.stem: 某廠商的投入-產出關係如下：
questions.explanation: 總產量依次是 6、20、39、60、80，邊際產量在第四部機器為 21、第五部降至 20，故邊際回報遞減在聘用第四部機器後出現。
questions.postVisualStem: 邊際回報遞減在聘用第 ______ 個單位機器後出現。

questions.topicGroup: 內部規模經濟/規模負經濟
questions.keyPoint: 內部規模經濟/規模負經濟
questions.stem: 大企業向銀行借貸時，借款利率較小型廠商低。這是 ________________ 的例子。
questions.explanation: 大企業因自身規模而獲得較低融資成本，屬內部規模經濟。

questions.topicGroup: 廠商的基本目標：利潤極大化
questions.keyPoint: 競爭性廠商如何選擇利潤極大化產出水平
questions.stem: 下表顯示某競爭性廠商的成本表。
questions.explanation: 競爭性廠商利潤極大化時價格等於邊際成本。第四單位令總成本由 $50 升至 $80，邊際成本為 $30。
questions.postVisualStem: 若該廠商的利潤極大化產出是4單位，市場價格是多少？

questions.keyPoint: 列出各類結合的可能動機
questions.stem: 某城市最大的化妝品連鎖店收購了第二大的化妝品連鎖店。以下哪一項最有可能是進行這項收購的目標？

choices.text: 令市場佔有率達到最高

questions.explanation: 收購同一市場的主要競爭者屬側向結合，主要目標是擴大市場佔有率。

questions.keyPoint: 了解各類結合的含義並加以舉例
questions.stem: 某建築公司與一間水泥廠合併。這是一個 _____________ 的例子。
questions.explanation: 水泥是建築公司的投入品；與水泥廠合併屬外部後向擴張。

questions.keyPoint: 列出各類結合的可能動機
questions.stem:
為分散經營風險，一間雜誌社可考慮

(1) 收購一間玩具廠。
(2) 與一間教科書出版社結合。
(3) 收購另一間雜誌社。
questions.explanation: 玩具業和教科書出版可分散於不同市場的風險；收購另一雜誌社會集中於相同市場。

questions.topicGroup: 均衡價格及均衡數量的決定
questions.keyPoint: 市場不均衡：供不應求及供過於求
questions.stem:
甲公司是一間皮鞋製造廠，它的倉庫經常有未賣出的存貨。以下哪(幾)項陳述是正確的？

(1) 皮鞋現時的價格低於市場清銷水平。
(2) 皮鞋的價格有下調的壓力。
(3) 皮鞋的交易量等於其需求量。
questions.explanation: 未賣存貨代表供過於求：價格高於均衡水平並有下調壓力，實際交易量等於需求量。

questions.keyPoint: 分析（有效）價格上限對（貨幣）價格、交易量及總收入等的影響
questions.stem: 當政府對甲物品實施價格上限，

choices.text: 現時的價格會高於市場清銷價格。
甲物品的需求上升會導致交易量上升。
甲物品的供應量小於其需求量。

questions.explanation: 有效價格上限低於均衡價格，出現供不應求，供應量少於需求量。

questions.keyPoint: 解釋需求改變和供應改變如何影響均衡價格和數量
questions.stem: 下圖顯示甲國的婚禮統籌服務市場。E0是原來的均衡點。
questions.explanation: 結婚人數增加令需求由 D0 右移至 D2；新廠商加入令供應由 S0 右移至 S2，新的交點是 E3。

visuals.alt: 甲國婚禮統籌服務市場的供需圖。

movements: 結婚人數增加使需求由 D0 向右移至 D2。
新廠商加入使供應由 S0 向右移至 S2。
diagramDetails.answerFocus: D2 與 S2 的交點為 E3，故選 C。

questions.postVisualStem: 近年，打算結婚的人不斷增加，婚禮統籌服務市場的樂觀前景亦吸引廠商加入市場。新的均衡點會處於 __________。

questions.keyPoint: 解釋需求改變和供應改變如何影響均衡價格和數量
questions.stem: 近年，化學肥料的生產成本顯著上升。同時，由於使用化學肥料對人體造成負面的影響，化學肥料的使用不及從前普遍。因此，化學肥料的價格 _____________，交易量 _____________。

choices.text: 上升 …… 可能上升、下降或維持不變
下降 …… 可能上升、下降或維持不變
可能上升、下降或維持不變 …… 上升
可能上升、下降或維持不變 …… 下降

questions.explanation: 成本上升減少供應，使用減少降低需求；兩者均令交易量下降，價格變化則不確定。

questions.keyPoint: 需求改變的影響
questions.stem: 下圖顯示即影即有相機膠卷的市場。

choices.text: 生產即影即有相機膠卷的成本上升。
即影即有相機的價格上升。
即影即有相機再度成為潮流。

questions.explanation: 即影即有相機與其膠卷是輔助品。相機價格上升會減少膠卷需求，令需求曲線由 D0 左移至 D1。

visuals.alt: 即影即有相機膠卷市場的需求曲線左移。

movements: 需求曲線由 D0 向左移至 D1。
diagramDetails.answerFocus: 即影即有相機價格上升減少對其膠卷的需求，故選 C。

questions.postVisualStem: 以下哪一項會導致需求曲線由D₀移動至D₁？

questions.keyPoint: 解釋相關物品價格、收入、價格預期、天氣、市場消費者人數等因素如何影響個別需求及市場需求
questions.stem: 印度甘蔗失收，人們開始減少使用蔗糖，改為使用葡萄糖。
questions.explanation: 蔗糖與葡萄糖是代替品。甘蔗失收令蔗糖較稀少，人們改用葡萄糖，葡萄糖需求向右移，符合圖 D。

visuals.alt: 蔗糖及葡萄糖市場的四個供需變動圖。

movements: 甘蔗失收減少蔗糖供應。
人們改用葡萄糖，令葡萄糖需求右移。
diagramDetails.answerFocus: 圖 D 顯示葡萄糖需求由 D0 向右移至 D1，故選 D。

questions.postVisualStem: 以下哪一幅圖最能夠形容以上的情況？

questions.chapterTitle: 需求和供應的價格彈性
questions.keyPoint: 需求價格彈性和總收入之間的關係
questions.stem:
由於生產成本上漲，筆記簿的價格由$4上升至$6，交易量則下降33%。以下哪(幾)項陳述是正確的？

(1) 筆記簿的需求上升。
(2) 筆記簿的需求屬低彈性。
(3) 總收入下降。
questions.explanation: 成本上升是供應減少而非需求增加。價格上升 50%、交易量下降 33%，需求屬低彈性，總收入上升。

questions.chapterTitle: 需求和供應的價格彈性
questions.keyPoint: 需求價格彈性的類型
questions.stem: 由於海水受到污染，吞拿魚的漁獲下降。結果，吞拿魚的價格和交易量改變，改變的百分率分別是40%和55%。我們可以斷定

choices.text: 吞拿魚的需求屬低彈性。
吞拿魚的需求屬有彈性。
吞拿魚的供應屬低彈性。
吞拿魚的供應屬有彈性。

questions.explanation: 漁獲下降令供應減少，沿需求曲線移動。交易量變動比例較價格大，故吞拿魚需求屬有彈性。

questions.chapterTitle: 需求和供應的價格彈性
questions.keyPoint: 需求價格彈性和總收入之間的關係
questions.stem: 陳先生是一名廚櫃製造商。若廚櫃的需求屬 ____________，他便可以透過調低價格去增加總收入。
questions.explanation: 需求有彈性時，減價帶來的交易量百分比上升大於價格百分比下降，故總收入增加。

questions.chapterTitle: 需求和供應的價格彈性
questions.keyPoint: 需求價格彈性的類型
questions.stem: 當咖啡的價格上升，小森會花相同的金額購買咖啡，而啟文會購買相同數量的咖啡。小森對咖啡的需求屬 __________，而啟文對咖啡的需求屬 __________。

choices.text: 完全無彈性 …… 單一彈性
單一彈性 …… 完全彈性
完全彈性 …… 完全無彈性
單一彈性 …… 完全無彈性

questions.explanation: 支出不變代表單一彈性；數量不變代表完全無彈性。

questions.topicGroup: 物品及服務的稅項（銷售稅）
questions.keyPoint: 了解需求及供應價格彈性如何影響稅項負擔分配
questions.stem: 假設政府向生產者而非消費者徵收從量銷售稅。若需求彈性較供應彈性高，以下哪項是正確的？

choices.text: 消費者的稅項負擔會比生產者的小。
消費者的稅項負擔會比生產者的大。
消費者會承擔起全部的稅項負擔。
生產者會承擔起全部的稅項負擔。

questions.explanation: 稅項負擔取決於相對彈性，而非法律上向誰徵收。較有彈性的需求方承擔較小部分。

questions.keyPoint: 分析（有效）配額對價格、交易量、總收入及產品質素等的影響
questions.stem: 以下哪項關於有效配額和有效價格下限的陳述是不正確的？

choices.text: 它們都可能導致總收入下降。
它們都會導致市場不均衡。
它們都會導致市場價格上升。
它們都會導致交易量下降。

questions.explanation: 有效配額把交易量限制在配額水平，不必出現供過於求或供不應求；有效價格下限則會造成供過於求。

questions.keyPoint: 辨識市場結構種類
questions.stem: 完成收購加州集團後，紐約集團成為甲國的卡拉OK服務行業內的唯一廠商。甲國的卡拉OK服務的市場結構會由________ 轉變為 ________。

choices.text: 壟斷性競爭 …… 寡頭壟斷
寡頭壟斷 …… 壟斷性競爭

questions.explanation: 兩個主要服務供應者屬寡頭壟斷；收購後只剩一家廠商，市場轉為壟斷。

questions.keyPoint: 列出不同市場結構的一般特徵
questions.stem: 以下哪項不是壟斷性競爭市場的特徵？

choices.text: 廠商可以自由進出市場。
市場有數名具支配力的賣家，而其他賣家的市場佔有率不高。
不論買家或賣家都不能完全掌握市場資訊。
市場有大量的買家和賣家。

questions.explanation: 數名具支配力的賣家是寡頭壟斷的特徵；壟斷性競爭有大量賣家、較容易進出及不完全資訊。

questions.chapterTitle: 效率、公平和政府的角色(I)
questions.keyPoint: 總社會盈餘達致最大：邊際利益等於邊際成本
questions.stem: 以下哪個情況會達致效率？

choices.text: 消費者盈餘極大化，而生產者盈餘極小化
總利益與總成本的差距極大化

questions.explanation: 效率在總社會盈餘，即總利益減總成本，達到最大時實現。

questions.chapterTitle: 效率、公平和政府的角色(I)
questions.keyPoint: 負面界外效應與經濟無效率；把外部成本內在化
questions.stem: 明軒和凱怡是一起工作的同事。明軒經常在辦公時間與其他人高聲談笑，妨礙凱怡工作。假設凱怡有權在寧靜的環境中工作，以下哪項陳述是正確的？

choices.text: 明軒會停止在辦公時間與其他人高聲談笑。
私人與社會成本沒有出現分歧。
只有當明軒停止在辦公時間與其他人高聲談笑，私人與社會成本才不會出現分歧。
當明軒需對凱怡作出補償，金額按談話造成的邊際界外成本計算，私人與社會成本就不會出現分歧。

questions.explanation: 按邊際界外成本作補償會把外部成本內在化，令私人與社會成本一致；權利本身不保證他停止談笑。

questions.chapterTitle: 效率、公平和政府的角色(I)
questions.keyPoint: 負面界外效應與經濟無效率；把外部成本內在化
questions.stem: 港鐵公司興建南港島線(東段)，這會縮短由海洋公園、黃竹坑、利東及海怡半島往金鐘所需的交通時間。因此，人們現在要購買這些地區的私人住宅，需要付出較高的價錢。以下哪項是正確的？

choices.text: 私人與社會成本出現分歧，政府應該對將在這些地區購買私人住宅的人士提供津貼，以減少分歧。
私人與社會利益出現分歧，政府應該對已在這些地區購買私人住宅的人士提供津貼，以減少分歧。
私人與社會成本可能沒有出現分歧。
除非政府對將於這些地區購買私人住宅的人士提供津貼，否則私人與社會成本不會出現分歧。

questions.explanation: 住宅市價上升本身不足以證明私人與社會成本出現分歧；資料仍可能沒有外部成本。

questions.chapterTitle: 效率、公平和政府的角色(II)
questions.keyPoint: 詮釋洛倫茨曲線提供的資料
questions.stem: 下圖顯示了甲國和乙國的洛倫茨曲線。
questions.explanation: 乙國的洛倫茨曲線較接近均等線，收入較平均、堅尼系數較低；洛倫茨曲線不能比較平均收入。

visuals.alt: 甲國及乙國的洛倫茨曲線。

movements: 乙國曲線較接近均等線，表示收入分配較平均。
diagramDetails.answerFocus: 乙國堅尼系數較低，且無法從圖得出平均收入，故只有 (2) 正確。

questions.postVisualStem:
以下哪(幾)項是正確的？
(1) 乙國的堅尼系數高於甲國的堅尼系數。
(2) 乙國的收入分配較甲國的平均。
(3) 乙國住戶的平均收入較甲國的高。

questions.chapterTitle: 效率、公平和政府的角色(II)
questions.keyPoint: 詮釋堅尼系數提供的資料
questions.stem: 一個國家的堅尼系數越高，

choices.text: 該國低收入人士的收入便越低。
該國低收入人士與高收入人士的收入差距便越小。
該國的收入分配越平均。

questions.explanation: 較高堅尼系數代表收入不均較嚴重，但不能單憑它斷定低收入人士的絕對收入或各群組收入差距。

questions.chapterTitle: 效率、公平和政府的角色(II)
questions.keyPoint: 收入均等化
questions.stem: 以下哪項政策能減低收入不均？

choices.text: 將薪俸稅由累進稅轉為比例稅
減少對中小學教育的津貼
增加對豪宅徵收的物業稅

questions.explanation: 增加豪宅物業稅具較累進效果，可減低稅後收入不均；其餘政策較可能加劇不均。

questions.keyPoint: 稀少性和選擇的關係
questions.stem: 以下哪一項關於稀少性的陳述是正確的？

choices.text: 若某資源的供應是有限的，稀少性便存在。
只有發展中國家的人才會面對稀少性的問題。
稀少性的存在意味着人們需要作出選擇。

questions.explanation: 稀少性表示資源相對於慾望不足，因而必須作出選擇；有限供應不必然稀少，稀少性亦不等於短缺。

questions.keyPoint: 識別及計算選擇一個選項時涉及的成本（顯性成本及隱含成本）
questions.stem: 電子版《清明上河圖》展覽會於亞洲國際博覽館舉行，每張門票的售價為$10。祖堯在售票處排隊兩小時才能購買門票，以致他無法上網球課。以下哪項陳述是正確的？

choices.text: 祖堯獲得一張門票的機會成本是$10。
祖堯獲得一張門票的機會成本高於$10。
若祖堯的媽媽為門票付款，他獲得一張門票的機會成本會是零。
祖堯獲得一張門票的機會成本是用於排隊購買門票的兩小時。

questions.explanation: 門票售價是顯性成本，放棄網球課是隱含成本，故取得門票的機會成本高於 $10。

questions.keyPoint: 區分免費物品及經濟物品
questions.stem: 香港一些機構會為露宿者提供食物和向貧困人士提供緊急食物援助。這些食物被認為是經濟物品因為

choices.text: 只有露宿者和經社區中心轉介的人士才能獲得食物。
有需要的人士到這些機構需要支付交通費用。
人們都希望得到更多這些食物。
多於一人希望得到這些食物。

questions.explanation: 經濟物品相對於慾望是稀少的；人們希望得到更多食物正顯示這一點，即使食物免費提供。

questions.chapterTitle: 三個基本經濟問題與私有產權
questions.keyPoint: 私有產權的意思和在市場經濟中的重要性
questions.stem:
陳小姐是一位私人助理。她的老闆為她提供了一部智能手機以方便她日常工作。陳小姐最大可能對該智能手機擁有哪(幾)種私有產權？

(1) 智能電話的獨有使用權
(2) 把智能電話出租的收入專屬權
(3) 把智能電話出售的轉讓權
questions.explanation: 陳小姐可能獲准使用老闆的手機，但沒有把它出租或出售的權利。

questions.keyPoint: 比較不同所有權形式的特徵及利弊
questions.stem: 張先生和鄧先生共同擁有一間廠商，他們都享有有限債務責任。以下哪一項必定是正確的？

choices.text: 該廠商在證券交易所上市。
張先生可以在沒有鄧先生同意的情況下將他的股份轉讓給其他人。
他們不需要向公眾公開其財務報表。
即使張先生去世，鄧先生仍可繼續經營該廠商。

questions.explanation: 有限債務責任表示這是有限公司，具有永續性，故其中一位東主去世後可繼續經營；不必上市或容許自由轉讓股份。

questions.keyPoint: 私用品及共用品
questions.stem: 一些咖啡室提供的紙牌遊戲屬於
questions.explanation: 紙牌由咖啡室用來提供服務，屬生產者物品；它具競爭性及排他性，屬私用品。

questions.keyPoint: 不同的付酬方式
questions.stem:
某出版社傾向以計件工資制度，而不用計時工資制度僱用一名翻譯員。這可能是因為

(1) 出版社能較容易控制生產成本。
(2) 確保翻譯員不會躲懶的成本會較低。
(3) 監控產出質素的成本會較低。
questions.explanation: 計件工資使薪酬與產出掛鈎，較易控制成本和減少躲懶；為免質素下降，監控質素的需要反而可能較大。

questions.topicGroup: 短期投入與產出的關係
questions.keyPoint: 邊際回報遞減定律
questions.stem: 下表顯示甲工廠的資料。
questions.explanation: 5、6、7 個工人的總產量依次為 100、150、210，邊際產量升至第 7 個工人的 60。第 8 個工人的邊際產量必須低於 60，故 265 單位可能。
questions.postVisualStem: 若僱用第7個工人後出現邊際回報遞減，8個工人的總產量可能是

questions.topicGroup: 廠商的基本目標：利潤極大化
questions.keyPoint: 競爭性廠商如何選擇利潤極大化產出水平
questions.stem: 細閱以下某競爭性廠商的資料。
questions.explanation: 邊際成本依次為 $16、$18、$20、$22。競爭性廠商在邊際成本等於價格時生產 3 單位，邊際收入等於市場價格 $20。
questions.postVisualStem: 假設市場價格是$20。利潤極大化產出水平是 ________ 單位，而邊際收入是 ________。

questions.keyPoint: 了解各類結合的含義並加以舉例
questions.stem: 馬太太經營一個種植有機蔬菜的農場。近日，她收購了一間售賣有機產品的店舖。這是一個 ____________ 的例子，而馬太太可以透過這項擴張 ____________。

choices.text: 後向擴張 …… 確保西餐廳有穩定的材料供應
後向擴張 …… 分散收入來源
前向擴張 …… 為有機食品建立銷售網絡
前向擴張 …… 增加其有機店舖的市場佔有率

questions.explanation: 收購零售店舖是向消費者方向的前向擴張，可為農場的有機食品建立銷售網絡。

questions.topicGroup: 均衡價格及均衡數量的決定
questions.keyPoint: 市場不均衡：供不應求及供過於求
questions.stem: 下表顯示物品 X 的市場供應表。

choices.text: 當物品 X 的價格為$10 時，物品 X 的需求量少於 500 單位。
當物品 X 的價格為$30 時，總收入為$21,000。
當物品 X 的價格為$40 時，交易量低於 800 單位。
當物品 X 的價格為$50 時，需求量為 900 單位。

questions.explanation: 價格高於均衡價格時，需求量低於均衡交易量，亦低於供應量。因此價格為 $40 時，交易量低於 800 單位。

visuals.caption: 物品 X 的市場供應表

questions.postVisualStem: 假設物品 X 的均衡價格是$20。以下哪項陳述是正確的？

questions.keyPoint: 解釋需求改變和供應改變如何影響均衡價格和數量
questions.stem: 下圖顯示香港的涼茶市場。E0 是原來的均衡點。
questions.explanation: 部分市民減少飲用涼茶令需求左移；草藥價格上升令供應左移。兩者的新交點是 E1。

visuals.alt: 香港涼茶市場的供需圖。

movements: 健康警告令需求由 D0 左移至 D1。
草藥價格上升令供應由 S0 左移至 S1。
diagramDetails.answerFocus: 新均衡位於 E1，故選 A。

questions.postVisualStem: 一些註冊中醫師提醒市民並非所有人的體質都適合飲用涼茶，有些人飲用涼茶後可能會出現副作用。假設有部分市民減少飲用涼茶，而同時大部分草藥的價格都上升。新的均衡點會是 _______。

questions.keyPoint: 勞力供應
questions.stem:
甲國的經濟近年迅速發展。建造業的樂觀前景吸引了很多畢業生加入建造業。另外，很多新的酒店亦正在興建。

以下哪一項陳述必定是正確的？

choices.text: 受聘的建築工人的數目上升。
建築工人的工資率上升。
建築工人的總收入上升。
用於聘請建築工人的總支出上升。

questions.explanation: 畢業生加入使勞力供應增加，新酒店建設使勞力需求增加；兩者均令均衡受僱建築工人數目上升，工資及總支出變化則不確定。

questions.chapterTitle: 需求和供應的價格彈性
questions.keyPoint: 需求價格彈性的類型
questions.stem: 乙國的原子筆市場有兩個具支配力的生產商，分別是甲生產商和乙生產商。甲生產商於年初破產並倒閉了。甲生產商倒閉後，乙生產商的原子筆的價格由$6上升至$8，而交易量則上升了50%。我們可以推斷出

choices.text: 乙生產商的原子筆的需求價格彈性大於1。
乙生產商的原子筆的需求價格彈性小於1。
乙生產商的原子筆的供應價格彈性大於1。
乙生產商的原子筆的供應價格彈性小於1。

questions.explanation: 甲廠商倒閉使乙廠商原子筆的需求上升。交易量升 50%，價格約升 33%，故乙廠商的供應屬有彈性。

questions.topicGroup: 物品及服務的稅項（銷售稅）
questions.keyPoint: 分析從量稅對價格、交易量及總收入等的影響，並說明生產者和消費者的稅項負擔分配
questions.stem: 下表顯示物品 X 的市場需求和供應。
questions.explanation: 稅楔為 $3，消費者付 $10、生產者收 $7，交易量為 110 單位，總稅收為 $330。新均衡附近需求彈性較供應彈性高。

visuals.caption: 物品 X 的市場需求和供應

questions.postVisualStem: 假設該國政府對物品 X 徵收$3的從量稅。政府所得的總稅收為 _______。物品 X 的需求彈性較供應彈性 _______。

questions.keyPoint: 分析（有效）價格下限對（貨幣）價格、交易量及總收入等的影響
questions.stem:
假設政府對某物品實施有效價格下限。以下哪(幾)項是正確的？

(1) 該物品出現短缺。
(2) 若該物品的需求屬有彈性，人們在購買這該品方面的總支出減少。
(3) 物品的交易量下跌。
questions.explanation: 有效價格下限造成供過於求而非短缺，並令交易量下降；若需求有彈性，價格上升使總支出下降。

questions.keyPoint: 列出不同市場結構的一般特徵
questions.stem: 在香港，收費電視的市場結構一般會被認為是寡頭壟斷，因為

choices.text: 各大收費電視供應商所播放的電視節目很類似。
各大收費電視供應商都清楚知道其他供應商的市場策略。
各大收費電視供應商的市場佔有率是相同的。
當一個收費電視供應商推出推廣優惠，其他供應商很可能會跟隨。

questions.explanation: 寡頭壟斷廠商互相依存，一家推出推廣優惠時，其他主要供應商很可能作出反應。

questions.keyPoint: 分析（有效）配額對價格、交易量、總收入及產品質素等的影響
questions.stem: 假設甲國政府對某物品的供應實施配額限制。以下哪一項是正確的？

choices.text: 由於該物品的單位價格上升，生產者盈餘上升。
消費者盈餘下降，而所有消費者盈餘的損失會全部轉移至生產者。
由於出現淨損失，總社會盈餘下降。

questions.explanation: 有效配額限制交易量低於效率水平，會造成淨損失，令總社會盈餘下降；其餘效果不一定成立。

questions.chapterTitle: 效率、公平和政府的角色(I)
questions.keyPoint: 負面界外效應與經濟無效率；把外部成本內在化
questions.stem: 政府在某私人屋苑附近興建了一個新的堆填區，該堆填區發出惡臭，嚴重影響附近屋苑居民的生活，該屋苑的單位的市價亦因而大幅下跌。假設這些居民享有在空氣清新的環境居住的權利。以下哪一項陳述是正確的？

choices.text: 私人與社會成本沒有出現分歧，因為惡臭並非在該屋苑的範圍內所發出的。
若消除界外成本所涉及的成本高於所得的利益，私人和社會成本便不會出現分歧。
私人與社會成本的分歧只能透過關閉堆填區解決。
私人與社會成本的分歧可以透過向居民賠償金錢來消除。

questions.explanation: 惡臭為居民帶來界外成本；向居民作出相等於界外成本的賠償，可把外部成本內在化。

questions.chapterTitle: 效率、公平和政府的角色(II)
questions.keyPoint: 詮釋洛倫茨曲線提供的資料
questions.stem: 下圖顯示了兩個國家的洛倫茨曲線。
questions.explanation: 乙國曲線離均等線較遠，故高收入階層收入份額較大、堅尼系數較高；圖不能比較低收入階層的絕對收入。

visuals.alt: 甲國及乙國的洛倫茨曲線。

movements: 乙國的曲線較遠離均等線，顯示收入不均較嚴重。
diagramDetails.answerFocus: 只有 (2) 及 (3) 正確，故選 C。

questions.postVisualStem:
根據上圖，以下哪(幾)項陳述是正確的？
(1) 乙國低收入階層賺取的收入較甲國的為低。
(2) 乙國高收入階層較甲國高收入階層擁有較大百分比的總收入。
(3) 甲國的堅尼系數大於零及比乙國的堅尼系數小。

questions.keyPoint: 支出面
questions.stem: 下表顯示甲國某年的本地生產總值數據。

visuals.caption: 甲國某年的本地生產總值數據
rows: 本地固定資本形成總額

questions.postVisualStem: 若以要素成本計算的本地生產總值(以百萬元為單位)是333，X的數值是 ________。

questions.keyPoint: 生產面/增加價值面
questions.stem: 下圖顯示某經濟的電子閱讀器生產鏈。

visuals.alt: 電子閱讀器的本地生產鏈。

labels: 本地電子閱讀器製造商
本地電子閱讀器批發商
本地電子閱讀器零售商
movements: 進口零件價值為 $150,000。
本地最終消費及出口共同計入本地生產總值。
diagramDetails.answerFocus: 本地市價 GDP 貢獻為 $480,000，故選 B。

questions.postVisualStem: 上述生產鏈對該經濟以市價計算的本地生產總值的貢獻是 ________。

questions.keyPoint: 本地生產總值的增長率
questions.stem:
甲國某年的名義本地生產總值、實質本地生產總值及人口的增長率分別為7%、-2%和5%。以下哪幾項關於甲國的陳述是正確的？

(1) 一般物價水平上升了。
(2) 人均實質本地生產總值上升了。
(3) 人均名義本地生產總值上升了。
questions.explanation: 名義 GDP 增長快於實質 GDP，故一般物價水平上升。實質 GDP 與人口變動後的人均實質 GDP 下降；人均名義 GDP 上升。

questions.keyPoint: 本地居民總收入（本地居民生產總值）
questions.stem: 以下哪一項應包括在香港的本地居民生產總值，而不包括在本地生產總值的計算內？

choices.text: 一名香港居民在香港一間由日本人開設的公司工作六個月所得的收入
一名美國人在香港某公司工作六個月所得的收入
一名香港人向一名內地遊客出售一隻鑽石戒指所得的收入
一名香港人在紐約某公司工作六個月所得的收入

questions.explanation: 本地居民生產總值包括香港居民在海外賺取的收入；本地生產總值只計在香港境內的生產。

questions.keyPoint: 支出面
questions.stem: 在一個開放型經濟體系，Y = $300，C = $140，I = $100，G = $80，Sᴾ = $100，而Y、C、I、G和Sᴾ依次代表國民收入、私人消費支出、投資總額、政府消費支出和私人儲蓄。這表示該政府面對 __________________，而該經濟體系出現 __________________。

choices.text: 財政赤字 …… 淨資金流入
財政赤字 …… 淨資金外流
財政盈餘 …… 淨資金流入
財政盈餘 …… 淨資金外流

questions.explanation: 稅收為 Y - C - 私人儲蓄 = $60，政府儲蓄為 $60 - $80 = -$20，故有財政赤字。國民儲蓄為 $80，小於投資 $100，需淨資金流入。

questions.keyPoint: 國民收入統計數字的運用和限制
questions.stem: 與人均名義本地生產總值比較，人均實質本地生產總值能較準確地量度一個經濟體系的平均生活水準，因為

choices.text: 人口數目的變動已計算在內。
收入分配的影響已計算在內。
產出組合的影響已計算在內。
物價水平的變動已計算在內。

questions.explanation: 兩者均已按人口計算；實質本地生產總值進一步剔除物價水平變動，較能反映實際產出及平均生活水準。

questions.keyPoint: 導致總需求曲線移動的因素
questions.stem: 假設某經濟體系的政府調高利得稅稅率。這會導致

choices.text: 短期和長期總供應下降。

questions.explanation: 利得稅率上升減少企業保留盈利和投資支出，令總需求左移。

questions.topicGroup: 影響長期總供應的因素
questions.keyPoint: 影響長期總供應的因素
questions.stem: 在以下哪個情況，一個經濟的長期總供應會下降？

choices.text: 乾旱破壞了大部分的農作物

questions.explanation: 大量移民海外會減少勞動力及生產能力，令長期總供應左移。乾旱通常是短期供應衝擊。

questions.topicGroup: 總需求及/或總供應改變導致均衡產出水平和物價水平的改變
questions.keyPoint: 透過明確說明受影響的總需求組成部分及/ 或影響短期總供應及/或長期總供應的因素，解釋某情況會如何導致總需求、短期總供應及/ 或長期總供應轉變，因而令總需求曲線、短期總供應曲線及/或長期總供應曲線移動
questions.explanation: 圖中存在通縮差距。調低銷售稅會令短期總供應右移，在不推高物價下回復充分就業產出。

visuals.alt: 總需求、短期總供應及長期總供應圖。

labels: 產出量（實質本地生產總值）
movements: 經濟產出低於 LRAS 所示的充分就業水平。
降低銷售稅令 SRAS 右移。
diagramDetails.answerFocus: 選項 B 使 SRAS 右移，故不推高物價而回復長期均衡。

questions.postVisualStem: 假設某經濟的產出水平現處於Y*。以下哪項可以在不令物價水平上升的情況下幫助該經濟回復至長期均衡？

questions.topicGroup: 總需求及/或總供應改變導致均衡產出水平和物價水平的改變
questions.keyPoint: 透過明確說明受影響的總需求組成部分及/ 或影響短期總供應及/或長期總供應的因素，解釋某情況會如何導致總需求、短期總供應及/ 或長期總供應轉變，因而令總需求曲線、短期總供應曲線及/或長期總供應曲線移動
questions.stem: 假設某經濟起初處於長期均衡狀態。當本地貨幣升值，在長期內，物價水平會 ____________，而均衡產出水平會 ____________。
questions.explanation: 貨幣升值令進口較便宜及出口需求下降，壓低物價；長期產出仍由生產能力決定，維持不變。

questions.topicGroup: 總需求及/或總供應改變導致均衡產出水平和物價水平的改變
questions.keyPoint: 透過明確說明受影響的總需求組成部分及/ 或影響短期總供應及/或長期總供應的因素，解釋某情況會如何導致總需求、短期總供應及/ 或長期總供應轉變，因而令總需求曲線、短期總供應曲線及/或長期總供應曲線移動
questions.stem: 假設某經濟起初處於長期均衡狀態。當 _________________________________，在長期內，均衡產出水平會上升，而物價水平的變動則是不確定的。

choices.text: 政府增加在長者服務方面的支出
政府決定興建新的高速公路

questions.explanation: 新高速公路提升生產能力，令 LRAS 右移；它亦可能影響總需求，故長期物價水平變動不確定，而產出上升。

questions.topicGroup: 影響長期總供應的因素
questions.keyPoint: 影響長期總供應的因素
questions.stem: 假設某經濟起初處於均衡狀態。若該經濟引入一種既高效率又環保的能源，

choices.text: 長期總供應曲線會向右移。
短期和長期總供應曲線都會向右移。
總需求、短期總供應和長期總供應曲線都會向右移。

questions.explanation: 更高效率的能源降低生產成本並增加生產能力，令短期和長期總供應曲線右移。

questions.keyPoint: 以物易物和它的限制
questions.stem:
當某以物易物經濟轉為一個使用貨幣交易的經濟，以下哪(幾)項可能會發生？

(1) 物品及服務的交易的成本降至零。
(2) 決定交易比率較從前容易。
(3) 進行小額交易較從前容易。
questions.explanation: 貨幣提供共同計價單位及可分割性，令交易比率和小額交易更方便；它不會使交易成本降至零。

questions.keyPoint: 良好貨幣的特質
questions.stem: 與9999黃金比較，在進行大額交易時，紙幣是一種較佳的貨幣形式，因為
questions.explanation: 紙幣較黃金輕便，進行大額交易時更易攜帶和轉移。

questions.keyPoint: 中央銀行的職能如何在香港執行
questions.stem: 以下哪項不是香港金融管理局的工作？
questions.explanation: 金管局管理外匯儲備、監管銀行及執行貨幣政策；鈔票由發鈔銀行發行，硬幣由政府發行。

questions.topicGroup: 香港的持牌銀行、有限制牌照銀行及接受存款公司
questions.keyPoint: 三級接受存款機構的特徵
questions.stem: 以下哪一筆定期存款是持牌銀行和接受存款公司都可以接受，但不能被有限制牌照銀行接受的？
questions.explanation: 有限制牌照銀行只可接受不少於 $500,000、期限不少於三個月的存款；接受存款公司可接受不少於 $100,000、期限不少於三個月的存款，故 D 符合。

questions.keyPoint: 資產轉移對貨幣供應的影響
questions.stem: 志文從某本地持牌銀行的儲蓄存款中提取了$10,000。他把其中$4,000存放於一間有限制牌照銀行作定期存款，再把餘下的$6,000存放於一間持牌銀行作活期存款。以下哪一項是上述行動對香港的貨幣供應的即時影響？

choices.text: 貨幣供應 M1 和 M3 皆維持不變。
貨幣供應 M1 增加，而貨幣供應 M2 維持不變。
貨幣供應 M1 增加，而貨幣供應 M2 減少。
貨幣供應 M2 增加，而貨幣供應 M3 維持不變。

questions.explanation: $6,000 由儲蓄存款轉為活期存款令 M1 增加；$4,000 存入有限制牌照銀行不計入 M2，令 M2 減少。

questions.keyPoint: 了解中央銀行行動如何影響貨幣基礎
questions.stem: 下表顯示某銀行系統的資產負債表。
questions.explanation: 法定儲備為 $2,500，儲備比率為 25%，最大銀行乘數為 4。貨幣供應為 $11,000，貨幣基礎為 $4,000，實際貨幣乘數為 2.75。

visuals.caption: 銀行系統的資產負債表

questions.postVisualStem:
假設公眾持有$1,000現金，而超額儲備的金額為$500。以下哪(幾)項陳述是正確的？
(1) 最大銀行乘數為3.33。
(2) 貨幣供應為$11,000。
(3) 貨幣乘數為2.75。

questions.keyPoint: 了解及計算存款、放款、貨幣供應等在存款創造/ 收縮過程後的最大及實際改變
questions.stem: 下表顯示某銀行系統的資產負債表。

visuals.caption: 銀行系統的資產負債表

questions.postVisualStem: 假設法定儲備比率為20%。某人從銀行系統中提取了$2,000。銀行存款的最大可能值會是 _________。

questions.keyPoint: 了解及計算最大及實際銀行乘數
questions.stem: 以下哪項會導致名義利率上升？

choices.text: 中央銀行發行更多貨幣。
人們較從前傾向使用電子貨幣。

questions.explanation: 名義收入上升會增加交易性貨幣需求；貨幣供應不變時，名義利率上升。

questions.keyPoint: 稀少性、競爭及歧視的關係
questions.stem:
以下哪(幾)項關於「稀少性」的描述是正確的？

(1) 當資源有限，「稀少性」必定存在。
(2) 「稀少性」的存在意味着人們需要互相競爭資源。
(3) 當人們作出選擇，「稀少性」的問題便得以解決。
questions.explanation: 資源有限本身不足以表示相對於慾望稀少，而選擇不能消除稀少性；稀少資源有不同用途，使用者需要競爭。

questions.keyPoint: 解釋在不同情況下成本如何改變
questions.stem: 假設李小姐正考慮以下其中一個選項：

choices.text: 該部智能電話的售價高於李小姐預期。
李小姐發現該部智能電話難於使用。
法國出現大罷工，當地大部分的交通受到影響。
演唱會的門票全部售罄。

questions.explanation: 購買智能電話的機會成本是最有價值的放棄選項，即法國交流團；法國交通受影響會改變該選項的價值。

visuals.caption: 李小姐的選項
rows: 參加一個前往法國的交流團

questions.postVisualStem: 以下哪項會改變李小姐選擇購買一部智能電話的機會成本？

questions.keyPoint: 區分免費物品及經濟物品
questions.stem: 在夏季的繁忙時段，巴士上的冷氣可被視為

choices.text: 經濟物品，因為人們想得到更多這些冷氣。
經濟物品，因為電力的價格已包括在巴士的車資內。
免費物品，因為人們可以盡情享用這些冷氣。
免費物品，因為這些冷氣並沒有其他用途。

questions.explanation: 繁忙時段的冷氣服務相對於乘客慾望是稀少的，乘客希望得到更多，故屬經濟物品。

questions.chapterTitle: 三個基本經濟問題與私有產權
questions.keyPoint: 不同社會解決基本經濟問題的方法
questions.stem: 在一個市場主導經濟裏，

choices.text: 私有產權受到良好保護。
所有資源都是由私人擁有。
資源分配是由價格訊息所指導的。

questions.explanation: 市場主導經濟以價格訊息引導資源分配；它不表示只有價格競爭、所有資源均私有或私有產權必定受良好保護。

questions.keyPoint: 比較不同所有權形式的特徵及利弊
questions.stem:
與合夥企業比較，私人有限公司

(1) 享有較低的利得稅稅率。
(2) 擁有較多的資金。
(3) 較容易實施分工。
questions.explanation: 私人有限公司不必然有較低稅率、較多資金或較容易分工，三項均非與合夥企業比較時必定成立的特徵。

questions.keyPoint: 私用品及共用品
questions.stem: 政府在公共圖書館提供的免費公共 Wi-Fi 無線上網服務可被視為
questions.explanation: 圖書館以 Wi-Fi 提供服務，故屬生產者物品；公共 Wi-Fi 可由多人同時使用且難以排除使用者，屬共用品。

questions.keyPoint: 不同的付酬方式
questions.stem: 張小姐是某電子零件生產商的經理。她正考慮採用以下的薪酬制度：利潤分享、計時工資和計件工資。若張小姐的目的是要提高員工的工作意欲以及減低監控產品質素的成本，她可以採用

choices.text: 利潤分享、計時工資和計件工資。

questions.explanation: 利潤分享把員工報酬與整體利潤連繫，能提高工作意欲而不直接鼓勵以犧牲質素換取更多件數；計件工資反而需要較多質素監控。

questions.topicGroup: 內部規模經濟/規模負經濟
questions.keyPoint: 內部規模經濟/規模負經濟
questions.stem: 規模負經濟會在以下哪個情況出現？

choices.text: 產量增加時，總成本上升。
邊際收入低於邊際成本。
產量增加時，平均成本上升。

questions.explanation: 規模負經濟是長期產量擴大時平均成本上升。

questions.keyPoint: 列出各類結合的可能動機
questions.stem: 假設香港一間超級市場收購了一個位於新西蘭的農場。以下哪項最不可能是這個行動的目的？

choices.text: 減少市場上的競爭對手

questions.explanation: 超級市場收購農場屬後向結合，可穩定供應、分散風險或降低平均成本；農場不是其零售市場的競爭對手。

questions.topicGroup: 均衡價格及均衡數量的決定
questions.keyPoint: 稀少性及短缺的分別
questions.stem: 以下哪項有關稀少性和短缺的描述並不正確？

choices.text: 只要將價格設定在均衡水平，短缺便會被消除。
稀少性會在市場清銷價格的水平存在。
稀少性存在時，短缺便會存在。
調整市場價格並不能消除稀少性的問題。

questions.explanation: 稀少性是資源相對於慾望不足，即使市場清銷、沒有短缺時仍會存在；短缺可由價格調整消除。

questions.topicGroup: 均衡價格及均衡數量的決定
questions.keyPoint: 市場不均衡：供不應求及供過於求
questions.stem:
海洋公園的門票價格固定在成人每位 $250。在農曆新年期間，有些市民花了數小時在售票處輪候購票，但門票在輪到他們前便已經售罄。以下哪(幾)項有關此現象的描述是正確的？

(1) 門票供不應求。
(2) 購買門票涉及價格競爭。
(3) 購買門票涉及非價格競爭。
questions.explanation: 門票售罄顯示供不應求；價格固定，排隊時間是非價格競爭而非價格競爭。

questions.keyPoint: 解釋需求改變和供應改變如何影響均衡價格和數量
questions.stem: 下圖顯示香港的雞蛋市場。E0 是原來的均衡點。
questions.explanation: 德國停止出口令供應由 S0 左移至 S1；衛生憂慮令需求由 D0 左移至 D1。新均衡點為 E1。

visuals.alt: 香港雞蛋市場的供需圖。

movements: 停止進口令供應由 S0 左移至 S1。
衛生憂慮令需求由 D0 左移至 D1。
diagramDetails.answerFocus: 兩線同時左移後的新均衡是 E1，故選 A。

questions.postVisualStem: 假設德國發現當地的農場飼料受污染後，停止向香港出口雞蛋。同時，香港市民普遍因擔憂雞蛋的衛生情況而減少購買雞蛋。新的均衡點會在

questions.chapterTitle: 需求和供應的價格彈性
questions.keyPoint: 需求價格彈性和總收入之間的關係
questions.stem: 由於生產成本上升，朱古力的均衡價格上升 35%，而銷售者的總收入增加了 10%。我們可以推論出

choices.text: 朱古力的需求屬於低彈性。
朱古力的供應屬於有彈性。
朱古力的需求較其供應有彈性。
朱古力的需求價格彈性是 3.5。

questions.explanation: 價格上升而總收入亦上升，表示價格上升百分比大於需求量減少百分比，故需求屬低彈性。

questions.chapterTitle: 需求和供應的價格彈性
questions.keyPoint: 量度需求價格彈性
questions.stem: 由於運費下調，澳洲葡萄酒的價格由 $70 下降至 $50，而需求量則上升了 20%。澳洲葡萄酒的需求弧彈性是
questions.explanation: 價格變動百分比按中點公式為 20 / 60 = 33.3%，需求量增 20%，弧彈性為 20% / 33.3% = 0.6。

questions.keyPoint: 分析（有效）價格下限對（貨幣）價格、交易量及總收入等的影響
questions.stem: 參閱下圖。

choices.text: 甲物品的市場會出現供不應求的情況。
銷售者的總收入可能上升、下降或維持不變，取決於甲物品的需求和供應彈性。
交易量會少於 50 單位。

questions.explanation: 均衡價格是 $10，價格下限 $8 低於均衡價格而無效，市場維持原均衡，故不會出現黑市。

visuals.alt: 甲物品的市場供需圖，均衡價格為 $10、均衡數量為 50。

movements: 價格下限 $8 低於均衡價格 $10，故不是有效價格下限。
diagramDetails.answerFocus: 無效價格下限不改變均衡，黑市不會出現，故選 C。

questions.postVisualStem: 甲物品的市場最初處於均衡狀態。若政府把價格下限設定為 $8，

questions.topicGroup: 物品及服務的稅項（銷售稅）
questions.keyPoint: 了解需求及供應價格彈性如何影響稅項負擔分配
questions.stem: 假設政府向某物品開徵銷售稅。若該物品的需求屬於有彈性，而供應屬於低彈性，銷售者的總收入會 __________，消費者的稅項負擔會比生產者的 __________。
questions.explanation: 需求有彈性時價格上升令銷售者總收入下降；較無彈性的供應一方承擔較大稅負，故消費者負擔較生產者小。

questions.topicGroup: 物品及服務的 津貼
questions.keyPoint: 分析從量津貼對價格、交易量及總收入等的影響，並說明生產者和消費者如何分配津貼得益
questions.stem: 下表顯示某物品的市場需求及市場供應。
questions.explanation: 交易量為 20 時，需求表顯示消費者付 $2，供應表顯示生產者收 $5，故從量津貼為 $3。消費者總支出是 $2 x 20 = $40，而政府總津貼是 $3 x 20 = $60；只有 (1) 及 (3) 正確。

visuals.caption: 某物品的市場需求及市場供應

questions.postVisualStem:
若政府向生產者提供從量津貼後，該物品的交易量為 20 單位，我們可以推論出

(1) 從量津貼的金額是 $3。
(2) 消費者的總支出是 $100。
(3) 政府支付的總津貼金額為 $60。

questions.keyPoint: 舉出壟斷性競爭、寡頭壟斷及壟斷的例子
questions.stem: 在香港，以下哪項最不可能是寡頭壟斷的例子？
questions.explanation: 中式酒樓數目眾多，最不符合少數主要廠商主導、互相依存的寡頭壟斷特徵。

questions.chapterTitle: 效率、公平和政府的角色(I)
questions.keyPoint: 負面界外效應與經濟無效率；把外部成本內在化
questions.stem: 界外損害的出現意味着

choices.text: 邊際私人利益必定高於邊際社會利益。
市場必定出現生產不足的情況。
私人成本和社會成本出現分歧。
市場需要政府干預以助產出回到社會最優配置水平。

questions.explanation: 界外損害是負面界外效應，表示外部成本令邊際社會成本高於邊際私人成本。

questions.chapterTitle: 效率、公平和政府的角色(II)
questions.keyPoint: 詮釋堅尼系數提供的資料
questions.explanation: 甲國的洛倫茨曲線較接近均等線，故堅尼系數較小、收入分配較平均；堅尼系數介乎 0 與 1 之間。

visuals.alt: 甲國及乙國的洛倫茨曲線。

movements: 甲國曲線較接近均等線。
diagramDetails.answerFocus: (1) 及 (2) 正確，故選 B。

questions.postVisualStem:
根據上圖，以下哪(幾)項陳述是正確的？

(1) 甲國的堅尼系數比乙國的小。
(2) 兩國的堅尼系數都小於 1。
(3) 甲國的收入分配較乙國的不平均。

questions.keyPoint: 本地生產總值的增長率
questions.stem: 假設甲國在某年的人口增長率是 5%。在同一時期，名義本地生產總值和實質本地生產總值的增長率分別是 3% 和 7%。我們可推斷出
